```{=html}
<style>
/* ── Backing Track: a swing trio that follows an ABC chord chart ─────────── */
#bt-root{max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto;padding:1.25rem 1rem 4rem;color:var(--site-ink,#1e1c18);
  font-family:Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;line-height:1.5}
#bt-root *{box-sizing:border-box}
/* Quarto stamps its page grid onto divs inside .column-screen; keep ours plain blocks. */
#bt-root.page-columns,#bt-root .page-columns{display:block!important;grid-template-columns:none!important}
#bt-root .bt-intro{border-left:3px solid var(--site-accent,#3fc2b4);padding-left:1rem;margin:0 0 1.5rem;
  color:var(--site-ink-2,#5c5246);font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.6;max-width:680px}

#bt-root .bt-panel{background:var(--site-surface,#fff);border:1px solid var(--site-border,#e0d8ce);border-radius:10px;
  padding:.9rem 1rem;margin-top:1rem}
#bt-root .bt-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:.9rem 1.25rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
#bt-root .bt-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.3rem;min-width:0}
#bt-root .bt-field>label,#bt-root .bt-group-label{font-family:var(--font-mono,'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace);
  font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--site-ink-3,#9a8d7e);margin:0}
#bt-root select,#bt-root input[type=number],#bt-root input[type=text]{font:inherit;font-size:.9rem;height:2.2rem;padding:0 .55rem;
  border:1px solid var(--site-border,#e0d8ce);border-radius:7px;background:var(--site-surface,#fff);color:inherit}
#bt-root input[type=number]{width:4.6rem;font-family:var(--font-mono,'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#bt-root input[type=range]{accent-color:var(--site-accent-dk,#2b9c90);height:2.2rem;margin:0}
#bt-root :is(select,input,button,textarea,summary):focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--site-accent-dk,#2b9c90);outline-offset:2px}

/* transport */
#bt-root .bt-play{min-width:7.5rem;height:2.6rem;padding:0 1.1rem;border:0;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;
  background:var(--site-accent,#3fc2b4);color:var(--site-accent-text,#0a4f47);
  font-family:var(--font-display,'Oswald',system-ui,sans-serif);font-size:1rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase}
#bt-root .bt-play:hover{background:#52cdc0}
#bt-root .bt-play[data-state="playing"]{background:var(--site-accent-text,#0a4f47);color:#fff}
#bt-root .bt-play[data-state="loading"]{background:var(--site-surface-2,#f2ede5);color:var(--site-ink-2,#5c5246)}
#bt-root .bt-play:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}
#bt-root .bt-beats{display:flex;gap:.4rem;align-items:center;height:2.6rem}
#bt-root .bt-beats i{width:.62rem;height:.62rem;border-radius:50%;background:var(--site-border,#e0d8ce)}
#bt-root .bt-beats i.on{background:var(--site-accent,#3fc2b4)}
#bt-root .bt-beats i.on:first-child{background:var(--site-accent-text,#0a4f47)}
#bt-root .bt-tempo{flex:0 0 auto}
#bt-root .bt-inline{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem}
#bt-root .bt-inline input[type=range]{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:6rem}
#bt-root .bt-unit{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--site-ink-3,#9a8d7e)}
#bt-root .bt-status{margin:.7rem 0 0;min-height:1.3em;font-family:var(--font-mono,'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace);
  font-size:.78rem;color:var(--site-ink-2,#5c5246)}
#bt-root .bt-status.is-error{color:var(--site-fail,#b5251c)}

/* band options + mixer */
#bt-root .bt-mixer{display:flex;gap:.9rem 1.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;width:100%;margin-top:.9rem;padding-top:.8rem;border-top:1px solid var(--site-border-soft,#ece6dc)}
#bt-root .bt-mixer .bt-field{flex:1 1 7rem;max-width:14rem}
#bt-root .bt-mixer input[type=range]{width:100%}
#bt-root .bt-eq{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(11rem,1fr));gap:.8rem 1.2rem;margin-top:.7rem}
#bt-root .bt-eq .bt-eq-band{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.25rem;font-size:.82rem}
#bt-root .bt-eq .bt-eq-band input[type=range]{width:100%}
#bt-root .bt-eq .bt-eq-band output{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;float:right}
#bt-root [hidden]{display:none!important}

/* the chart with the chord diagram beside it (above it on a narrow screen) */
#bt-root .bt-chartrow{display:flex;gap:1rem;align-items:flex-start}
#bt-root .bt-chartrow #bt-chart{flex:1 1 0;min-width:0}
#bt-root .bt-side{flex:0 0 clamp(18rem,36vw,34rem);position:sticky;top:4.5rem;padding:.7rem .8rem;border:1px solid var(--site-border,#e0d8ce);border-radius:10px;background:var(--site-surface,#fff);
  --bt-now:#1f8f83;--bt-next:#e08a1e}
#bt-root .bt-side iframe{display:block;width:100%;height:16rem;border:0;margin-top:.5rem;background:#fff}
#bt-root .bt-side p{margin:0 0 .25rem;font-size:.92rem;line-height:1.35}
#bt-root .bt-side p b{font-size:1.1rem;margin-right:.35rem}
#bt-root .bt-side p small{color:var(--site-ink-2,#5c5246)}
#bt-root .bt-side .bt-sw{display:inline-block;width:.85rem;height:.85rem;border-radius:50%;margin-right:.4rem;vertical-align:-.08rem;background:var(--bt-now)}
#bt-root .bt-side .bt-sw.is-next{background:transparent;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 .22rem var(--bt-next)}
#bt-root .bt-side .bt-side-tag{display:inline-block;min-width:2.7rem;font:600 .68rem/1 var(--font-mono,monospace);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--site-ink-2,#5c5246)}
@media (max-width:900px){
  #bt-root .bt-chartrow{flex-direction:column}
  #bt-root .bt-chartrow #bt-chart{flex:none;width:100%}
  #bt-root .bt-side{order:-1;position:static;flex:none;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box}
}
/* bars that do not add up to their meter */
#bt-root .bt-barwarn{margin-top:.8rem;padding:.6rem .8rem;border:1px solid #e3b071;border-left:4px solid #d9822b;border-radius:8px;background:#fdf4e7;font-size:.9rem}
#bt-root .bt-barwarn p{margin:0 0 .35rem}
/* the list of sections down the left (a row of links on a narrow screen) */
#bt-root.bt-has-nav{max-width:1200px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:8.5rem minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:1.1rem;align-items:start}
#bt-root.bt-has-nav > *{grid-column:2;min-width:0}
#bt-root.bt-has-nav > .bt-nav{grid-column:1;grid-row:1 / span 60;position:sticky;top:4.5rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.15rem}
#bt-root .bt-nav a{display:block;padding:.3rem .5rem;border-radius:6px;font-size:.86rem;line-height:1.25;color:var(--site-ink-2,#5c5246);text-decoration:none;border-left:3px solid transparent}
#bt-root .bt-nav a:hover{background:var(--site-border-soft,#ece6dc);color:var(--site-ink,#1e1c18)}
#bt-root .bt-nav a.on{border-left-color:var(--site-accent,#3fc2b4);color:var(--site-ink,#1e1c18);font-weight:600}
@media (max-width:1000px){
  #bt-root.bt-has-nav{display:block}
  #bt-root.bt-has-nav > .bt-nav{position:static;flex-direction:row;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.2rem .3rem;margin-bottom:.6rem}
  #bt-root .bt-nav a{border-left:0;padding:.25rem .5rem;background:var(--site-border-soft,#ece6dc)}
}
/* chart display options + the note about pinned voicings */
#bt-root .bt-chartbar{margin-top:.8rem}
#bt-root .bt-chartbar .bt-field{flex:1 1 11rem;max-width:22rem}
#bt-root .bt-chartbar select{width:100%;max-width:100%}
#bt-root .bt-chartbar .bt-btn{height:2.2rem;white-space:normal;line-height:1.15;padding:.2rem .9rem}
#bt-root .bt-pinnote{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem .9rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 0 1rem;padding:.55rem .8rem;font-size:.88rem;
  border:1px solid var(--site-accent-dk,#2b9c90);border-radius:8px;background:var(--site-accent-bg,rgba(63,194,180,.12))}
#bt-root .bt-pinnote.is-info{border-color:var(--site-border,#e0d8ce);background:var(--site-surface-2,#f2ede5)}
#bt-root .bt-pinnote span{flex:1 1 14rem}
#bt-root .bt-pinnote .bt-btn{height:1.9rem;padding:0 .7rem;font-size:.84rem}
#bt-root .bt-pinnote .bt-x{width:1.9rem;padding:0;font-size:1.1rem;line-height:1}

/* ABC editor */
#bt-root .bt-abc summary,#bt-root .bt-fold summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:.92rem}
/* notation + MIDI export */
#bt-root .bt-fold .bt-row{margin-top:.8rem;align-items:center}
#bt-root .bt-check{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.35rem;font-size:.9rem;margin:0;cursor:pointer}
#bt-root .bt-check input{accent-color:var(--site-accent-dk,#2b9c90)}
#bt-root .bt-btn{height:2.2rem;padding:0 .9rem;border:1px solid var(--site-accent-dk,#2b9c90);border-radius:7px;background:var(--site-surface,#fff);
  color:var(--site-accent-text,#0a4f47);font:inherit;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
#bt-root .bt-btn:hover{background:var(--site-accent-bg,rgba(63,194,180,.12))}
#bt-root .bt-score{margin-top:.8rem;overflow-x:auto}
#bt-root .bt-score svg{max-width:100%;height:auto}
#bt-root .bt-abc textarea{display:block;width:100%;min-height:13rem;margin-top:.8rem;padding:.7rem .8rem;resize:vertical;
  border:1px solid var(--site-border,#e0d8ce);border-radius:7px;background:var(--site-surface-2,#f2ede5);color:inherit;
  font-family:var(--font-mono,'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace);font-size:.84rem;line-height:1.55;tab-size:2}
#bt-root .bt-hint{margin:.6rem 0 0;font-size:.84rem;color:var(--site-ink-2,#5c5246);max-width:70ch}
#bt-root .bt-hint code{font-size:.82rem;background:var(--site-surface-2,#f2ede5);padding:.05rem .3rem;border-radius:4px;color:inherit}
#bt-root .bt-hint.bt-warn{color:var(--site-warn-ink,#664d03)}
#bt-root .bt-hint.bt-warn:empty{display:none}

@media (max-width:720px){
  #bt-root .bt-mixer .bt-field{flex:1 1 5rem;max-width:none}
  #bt-root .bt-play{flex:1 1 auto}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){ #bt-root *{transition:none!important} }
/* practice: start bar, cycle, tempo steps */
#bt-root .bt-check{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.35rem;font-size:.88rem;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer}
#bt-root .bt-field>label.bt-check{font-family:inherit;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;color:inherit;height:2.2rem;font-size:.88rem}
#bt-root .bt-check input{accent-color:var(--site-accent-dk,#2b9c90)}
#bt-root #bt-practice input[type=number],#bt-root .bt-cyc input[type=number]{width:4.2rem}
#bt-root .bt-row2{margin-top:.8rem;padding-top:.7rem;border-top:1px solid var(--site-border-soft,#ece6dc)}
/* band section: one labelled group per player */
#bt-root .bt-sub{margin-top:.8rem;padding-top:.7rem;border-top:1px solid var(--site-border-soft,#ece6dc)}
#bt-root .bt-sub:first-of-type{border-top:0;padding-top:0}
#bt-root .bt-sub>h3{margin:0 0 .1rem;font-family:var(--font-display,'Oswald',system-ui,sans-serif);font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--site-ink-2,#5c5246);border:0;padding:0}
#bt-root .bt-sub .bt-row{margin-top:.4rem}
#bt-chart .tc-bar.bt-cyc{background:rgba(216,167,83,.2)}
#bt-chart .tc-bar.bt-cyc.tc-live{background:var(--tc-live-soft)}
#bt-chart .tc-bar.bt-cyc-end{box-shadow:inset -3px 0 0 var(--site-accent-dk,#2b9c90)}
#bt-chart .tc-bar.bt-stop::after{content:"STOP";position:absolute;bottom:3px;right:5px;font:700 .56rem/1 var(--font-mono,monospace);letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--site-ink-2,#5c5246)}
#bt-root .bt-kit{margin-top:.9rem;padding-top:.7rem;border-top:1px solid var(--site-border-soft,#ece6dc)}
#bt-root .bt-more{font-size:.84rem}
#bt-root .bt-more>summary{cursor:pointer;color:var(--site-ink-2,#5c5246)}
#bt-root .bt-morelist{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(13rem,1fr));gap:.2rem 1rem;margin-top:.4rem}
#bt-root .bt-morelist .bt-morehead{grid-column:1/-1;margin-top:.3rem;font-family:var(--font-mono,'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--site-ink-3,#9a8d7e)}
#bt-root .bt-morelist .bt-morehead:first-child{margin-top:0}
#bt-root .bt-morelist .bt-mixrow{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.1rem}
#bt-root .bt-morelist .bt-mixw{width:100%;max-width:11rem;margin:0 0 .25rem 1.3rem}
#bt-root .bt-morelist .bt-mixw[hidden]{display:none}
#bt-root .bt-more{margin-top:.55rem}
#bt-root .bt-morelist label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.35rem;font:inherit;font-size:.84rem;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;color:inherit;margin:0;cursor:pointer}
#bt-root .bt-info{margin-top:.7rem;font-size:.84rem}
#bt-root .bt-info>summary{cursor:pointer;color:var(--site-ink-2,#5c5246);font-weight:600;width:max-content}
#bt-root .bt-info .bt-hint,#bt-root .bt-info .bt-intro{margin-top:.4rem}
#bt-root .bt-about{margin:0 0 1rem}
#bt-root details.bt-fold[open]>summary{margin-bottom:.2rem}
#bt-root .bt-kit .bt-mixer{border-top:0;padding-top:0;margin-top:.6rem}
#bt-root #bt-stops,#bt-root #bt-lift,#bt-root #bt-half{width:6.5rem}
#bt-root #bt-fillbars{width:8.5rem}
#bt-root .bt-tabstrip{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:.6rem;margin:0 0 .4rem}
#bt-root .bt-tabstrip[hidden]{display:none}
#bt-root .bt-tabstrip select{height:1.9rem;font-size:.8rem}
#bt-chart .tc-systems[hidden]{display:none}
#bt-chart .bt-tabset{margin:0 0 .5rem}
#bt-chart .bt-tabset .nav-link{cursor:pointer}
#bt-chart .bt-tabset .tab-content{padding:.75rem .75rem .85rem;background:transparent}
#bt-chart .bt-next-line{display:flex;gap:.7rem;align-items:baseline;margin-top:.7rem;padding-top:.5rem;border-top:1px dashed var(--site-border,#e0d8ce);font-size:.86rem;color:var(--site-ink-2,#5c5246);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden}
#bt-chart .bt-next-line b{flex:0 0 auto;font:700 .66rem/1 var(--font-mono,monospace);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--site-ink-3,#9a8d7e)}
#bt-chart .bt-next-line span{flex:1 1 auto;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;font-weight:600}
#bt-chart .bt-tabset .nav-link.is-live::after{content:"";display:inline-block;width:.45rem;height:.45rem;margin-left:.4rem;border-radius:50%;background:var(--site-accent,#3fc2b4);vertical-align:.08em}
@media print{ #bt-root .bt-tabstrip,#bt-chart .bt-tabset .nav{display:none} #bt-chart .bt-tabset .tab-pane{display:block!important;opacity:1!important}
  #bt-chart .bt-tabset .tab-pane::before{content:attr(data-print-title);display:block;font-weight:700;margin:.8rem 0 .3rem} #bt-chart .tc-systems[hidden]{display:flex} }
#bt-chart .tc-bar.bt-start::before{content:"\25B6";position:absolute;top:3px;right:5px;font-size:.6rem;line-height:1;color:var(--site-accent-dk,#2b9c90)}
</style>

<div id="bt-root">
  <p class="bt-hint" id="bt-remote" role="status" hidden style="margin:0 0 .8rem;padding:.6rem .9rem;border:1px solid var(--site-accent-dk,#2b9c90);border-radius:8px">This window is playing <span id="bt-remote-song">a song</span> for the lyrics page that opened it: Play, Stop and the sections are driven from there, and everything on this page still works while it plays. <strong id="bt-remote-click">Click anywhere in this window once so that it is allowed to make sound.</strong> <span id="bt-remote-versions" hidden><label for="bt-remote-version" style="font-weight:600">Changes</label> <select id="bt-remote-version" style="max-width:16rem"></select> <span>The chords over the words follow this menu, and the ABC below when it is edited without moving a chord.</span></span></p>
  <div class="bt-panel">
    <div class="bt-row">
      <button type="button" id="bt-play" class="bt-play" data-state="idle">&#9654; Play</button>
      <div class="bt-beats" id="bt-beats" aria-hidden="true"></div>
      <div class="bt-field bt-tempo">
        <label for="bt-tempo-n">Tempo</label>
        <div class="bt-inline">
          <input type="hidden" id="bt-tempo" value="120">
          <input type="number" id="bt-tempo-n" min="40" max="300" step="1" value="120" aria-label="Tempo in beats per minute">
          <span class="bt-unit" id="bt-tempo-unit">bpm</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-key">Key</label><select id="bt-key"></select></div>
      <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-changes">Changes</label><select id="bt-changes"></select></div>
      <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-meter">Meter</label><select id="bt-meter"></select></div>
      <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-style" title="A genre and its defaults: feel, bass line, comping rhythm, drum groove, voicings and sounds that belong together. The Band panel below shows what it chose.">Style</label>
        <select id="bt-style"></select></div>
    </div>
    <div class="bt-row bt-row2">
      <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-feel">Feel</label>
        <select id="bt-feel"><option value="swing">Swing</option><option value="straight">Straight eighths</option></select></div>
      <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-timefeel" title="Half time: the band plays one of its bars across two bars of the chart, as if the tempo were halved. Double time: two of its bars inside each bar of the chart. The chart and the tempo stay as they are.">Time</label>
        <select id="bt-timefeel"><option value="normal" selected>Normal</option><option value="half">Half time</option><option value="double">Double time</option></select></div>
      <div class="bt-field" id="bt-timeparts-field" hidden><label for="bt-timeparts" title="Who changes to half or double time. Usually the bass and drums shift while the chords keep their own rhythm. 'Chords answer': in double time the chord instrument plays fewer, shorter hits and leans on the off-beats; in half time it lets chords ring and accents beat 3.">Who changes</label>
        <select id="bt-timeparts"><option value="bass drums" selected>Bass and drums; chords answer</option><option value="bass drums plain">Bass and drums; chords unchanged</option><option value="drums">Drums only; chords answer</option><option value="bass comp drums">Whole band</option></select></div>
      <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-countin">Count-in</label>
        <select id="bt-countin"><option value="1">1 bar</option><option value="2">2 bars</option><option value="0">None</option></select></div>
      <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-intro" title="Bars the band plays once, after the count-in and before the first chorus. Only when playing starts from bar 1.">Intro</label>
        <select id="bt-intro"><option value="none" selected>None</option><option value="vamp">Vamp on the first chord</option><option value="last">Last bars of the form</option></select></div>
      <div class="bt-field" id="bt-intro-more" hidden><label for="bt-intro-bars">Intro length</label>
        <select id="bt-intro-bars"><option value="2">2 bars</option><option value="4" selected>4 bars</option><option value="8">8 bars</option></select>
        <label class="bt-check" title="The bass and the chords play the intro alone; the drums come in at the top of the form."><input type="checkbox" id="bt-intro-nodrums"> Drums wait for bar 1</label></div>
      <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-choruses" title="How many times through the changes before the band ends. Repeat keeps going until you stop it.">Choruses</label>
        <select id="bt-choruses"><option value="0">Repeat</option><option value="1">1</option><option value="2">2</option><option value="3">3</option><option value="4">4</option><option value="6">6</option><option value="8">8</option></select></div>
      <div class="bt-field bt-cyc"><span class="bt-group-label" title="Loop a few bars: press L, then click the bar the loop should end on. L again turns it off and on.">Loop (L)</span>
        <div class="bt-inline">
          <label class="bt-check"><input type="checkbox" id="bt-cyc-on"> Loop bars</label>
          <input type="number" id="bt-cyc-from" min="1" value="1" aria-label="Loop from bar"><span class="bt-unit">to</span>
          <input type="number" id="bt-cyc-to" min="1" value="4" aria-label="Loop to bar">
        </div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="bt-row bt-row2" id="bt-live-row">
      <div class="bt-field"><span class="bt-group-label" title="The drummer plays a fill at the end of the bar that is sounding (or of the next bar, when this one is nearly over). F is the shortcut.">Drums (F)</span>
        <button type="button" class="bt-btn" id="bt-fill" disabled>Fill now</button></div>
      <div class="bt-field" id="bt-sections-field" hidden><label for="bt-hold" title="The chart has sections (P: lines in the ABC). Play through: the band plays them in order. Hold: the band goes round each section until you press Next section; then the drummer fills and the band moves on.">Sections</label>
        <div class="bt-inline">
          <select id="bt-hold"><option value="through" selected>Play through</option><option value="hold">Hold each until Next</option></select>
          <button type="button" class="bt-btn" id="bt-next" disabled title="Move on to the next section when this one ends. N is the shortcut.">Next section (N)</button>
          <span class="bt-unit" id="bt-secname" role="status"></span>
        </div>
        <div class="bt-inline" id="bt-sec-tools" hidden>
          <span class="bt-unit" id="bt-sec-note" role="status"></span>
          <button type="button" class="bt-btn" id="bt-sec-apply" hidden title="Give every section with this name the Band settings the menus show now.">Apply to every section of this kind</button>
          <button type="button" class="bt-btn" id="bt-sec-reset" hidden title="Forget the changes made to this section in the menus: it goes back to what the chart says.">Back to the chart's settings</button>
        </div></div>
    </div>
    <p class="bt-status" id="bt-status"></p>
    <p class="bt-hint" id="bt-loop-note" role="status"></p>
  </div>

  <details class="bt-info bt-about"><summary>About this page</summary>
  <p class="bt-intro">A swing trio that follows the changes below: upright bass, piano and drums. Pick the changes, set the key and tempo, and play along. The changes are plain ABC, so you can rewrite them at the bottom of the page.</p>
  </details>

  <div class="bt-pinnote" id="bt-pinnote" role="status" hidden>
    <span id="bt-pinnote-text"></span>
    <button type="button" class="bt-btn" id="bt-pin-clear">Clear pins</button>
    <button type="button" class="bt-btn bt-x" id="bt-pin-dismiss" aria-label="Dismiss this note">&times;</button>
  </div>

  <div class="bt-tabstrip" id="bt-tabstrip" hidden>
    <span class="bt-group-label">Sections of the chart</span>
    <select id="bt-tabview" aria-label="How the chart's sections are shown" title="One tab per section: a section that comes round again shares its tab. Tabs in playing order: a tab for every section as it is played. Whole chart: everything at once.">
      <option value="unique" selected>One tab per section</option><option value="order">Tabs in playing order</option><option value="all">Whole chart</option></select>
  </div>
  <div class="bt-chartrow">
    <div id="bt-chart"></div>
    <div class="bt-side" id="bt-side" role="complementary" aria-label="The chord sounding now and the one that follows"><div id="bt-side-body"></div></div>
  </div>

  <div class="bt-barwarn" id="bt-barwarn" role="status" hidden>
    <p id="bt-barwarn-text"></p>
    <label class="bt-check" title="Off: a bar that holds too little or too much is played as one full bar of its meter. On: it is played exactly as long as what is written in it."><input type="checkbox" id="bt-aswritten"> Play these bars as written</label>
  </div>

  <details class="bt-panel bt-fold bt-chartbar" id="bt-sec-chart" open>
    <summary>Chart</summary>
    <div class="bt-row">
      <label class="bt-check" title="The Chord Sheet's superimposed view beside the chart: the first four different chords on one keyboard (or fretboard, when the guitar is comping), with the chord sounding now and the one that follows picked out in two colours."><input type="checkbox" id="bt-side-on" checked> Chord diagram beside the chart</label>
      <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-roman">Chord symbols</label>
        <select id="bt-roman"><option value="off">Letters</option><option value="only">Roman numerals</option><option value="both">Both</option></select></div>
      <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-chartfor">Chart for</label>
        <select id="bt-chartfor"><option value="concert">Concert pitch</option>
          <option value="bb">B&#9837; instruments (soprano &amp; tenor sax, trumpet, clarinet)</option>
          <option value="eb">E&#9837; instruments (alto &amp; baritone sax)</option></select></div>
      <button type="button" class="bt-btn" id="bt-send">Show these voicings in Chord Sheet</button>
    </div>
    <p class="bt-hint" id="bt-chartfor-hint" hidden>Only the chart is transposed. The band, the Key menu, the ABC, the notation and the MIDI file stay in concert pitch.</p>
    <p class="bt-hint" id="bt-send-note" role="status"></p>
  </details>

  <details class="bt-panel bt-fold" id="bt-sec-band" open>
    <summary>Band</summary>
    <div class="bt-sub">
      <h3>Whole band</h3>
      <div class="bt-row">
        <div class="bt-field"><span class="bt-group-label">Combinations</span>
          <label class="bt-check" title="Normally each menu offers only what belongs in the chosen style. Unlocked, every menu lists everything, so you can put a montuno over swing time if you want to hear it."><input type="checkbox" id="bt-unlock"> <span id="bt-lock-icon" aria-hidden="true">&#128274;</span> Unlock: mix anything</label>
          <select id="bt-genre" hidden aria-label="Which genre the menus list while unlocked" title="While unlocked: list only the bass lines, rhythms, voicings and grooves of one genre, so that a Latin groove is easy to find from inside a hymn. What is in use now stays listed."></select></div>
        <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-variation" title="Strict plays each pattern exactly as chosen. Loose lets the band start sparse, build over four choruses and lift into each new one.">Variation</label>
          <select id="bt-variation"><option value="0">Strict</option><option value="0.6" selected>Some</option><option value="1">Loose</option></select></div>
        <div class="bt-field"><span class="bt-group-label">Listening</span>
          <label class="bt-check" title="The page listens through the microphone to how loudly you are playing and the band plays up and down with you: louder and busier when you dig in, quieter when you ease off. Wear headphones, or the microphone hears the band instead of you. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere. While this is on, the Notation panel cannot show the chorus ahead."><input type="checkbox" id="bt-follow"> Follow my playing (microphone, headphones on)</label>
          <span class="bt-hint" id="bt-follow-note" role="status" style="margin:0"></span></div>
        <div class="bt-field" id="bt-boom-field" hidden><label for="bt-boom" title="How hard the boom-chick is played. Subtle: long, soft bass notes, quiet chords and only a hi-hat foot and a soft kick from the drums. Polka power: short, hard bass notes and chords, a loud snare on 2 and 4 and the cymbal on every beat.">Boom-chick: subtle to polka power</label>
          <input type="range" id="bt-boom" min="0" max="100" step="5" value="35"></div>
        <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-stops" title="Stop time: on these bars the band plays beat 1 and stops; only the bass leads back into the next bar. They are written into the ABC as &quot;^stop&quot;, so they are saved with the chart.">Stop on bar</label>
          <input type="text" id="bt-stops" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="none" aria-describedby="bt-stops-hint"></div>
        <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-fills" title="How often the drummer fills. As it comes: into every section and chorus, and at the end of some four-bar phrases. Section ends only: into a section, a chorus and the top of the form, nowhere else. Never: only the fills you write on a bar or ask for with Fill now.">Drum fills</label>
          <select id="bt-fills"><option value="auto" selected>As it comes</option><option value="busy">Busier</option><option value="sections">Section ends only</option><option value="none">Never (only the ones I ask for)</option></select></div>
        <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-fillbars" title="Bars that always end with a fill, for example 8, 16. Add a size after the number: 8 small, 16 big. They are written into the ABC as &quot;^fill&quot;, so they are saved with the chart.">Fill on bar</label>
          <input type="text" id="bt-fillbars" placeholder="none"></div>
        <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-lift" title="The bars of the chorus, where the band plays up: the drums move from the hi-hat to the ride with a fill and a crash going in, and everyone is a little louder. Write ranges, for example 9-16 or 9-16, 25-32.">Chorus bars</label>
          <input type="text" id="bt-lift" placeholder="none"></div>
        <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-half" title="Bars the bass and drums play in half time (the backbeat on 3) while the chords carry on: a half-time chorus or breakdown. Bars go in pairs (1-2, 3-4, ...), so write ranges that start on an odd bar and end on an even one, for example 9-16.">Half-time bars</label>
          <input type="text" id="bt-half" placeholder="none"></div>
        <div class="bt-field"><label class="bt-check" title="In the second bar of each four-bar phrase the band plays the next chord early, on the and of 4, and holds it over the barline. Only where the chord changes there, and only in the rock and pop rhythms."><input type="checkbox" id="bt-push"> Push chords</label></div>
        <div class="bt-field" id="bt-figs-field" hidden><label for="bt-figs" title="A bass line or comping rhythm taken from a tune can play on every chorus, or on the first chorus only (the head), after which the band plays the style's usual parts.">Figure from the tune</label>
          <select id="bt-figs"><option value="always" selected>Every chorus</option><option value="head">First chorus only</option></select></div>
      </div>
      <p class="bt-hint" id="bt-style-note" role="status"></p>
      <p class="bt-hint" id="bt-stops-hint" hidden></p>
    </div>
    <div class="bt-sub">
      <h3>Bass</h3>
      <div class="bt-row">
        <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-bass">Bass line</label>
          <select id="bt-bass"></select></div>
        <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-bass-sound">Sound</label>
          <select id="bt-bass-sound"><option value="upright">Upright bass</option><option value="electric">Electric bass</option></select></div>
        <div class="bt-field" id="bt-walk-field" hidden><label for="bt-walk" title="How much of the time the bass walks. All the way left it stays in two (half notes); all the way right it walks every bar. In between it changes two bars at a time, walking more when the band is playing up.">In two &harr; walking</label>
          <input type="range" id="bt-walk" min="0" max="100" step="5" value="100"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="bt-sub">
      <h3>Comping</h3>
      <div class="bt-row">
        <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-comp">Instrument</label><select id="bt-comp"></select></div>
        <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-rhythm">Rhythm</label><select id="bt-rhythm"></select></div>
        <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-voicing">Chord voicings</label><select id="bt-voicing"></select></div>
        <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-vmove" title="Hold: one voicing per chord. Move: over a held chord the comping steps through inversions, led by the top note. Passing chords: in the sixth-diminished style, a diminished chord passes between inversions.">Voicing movement</label>
          <select id="bt-vmove"><option value="hold">Hold each chord</option><option value="move" selected>Move through inversions</option><option value="passing">Move, with passing chords</option></select></div>
        <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-ext" title="How often the comping adds colour the chart does not write: a 9th or 13th on a plain 7th chord, a 6th in place of a major 7th. Decided afresh each time a chord arrives. Extensions that ARE written are always played.">Unmarked extensions</label>
          <select id="bt-ext"><option value="0">Never (as written)</option><option value="0.35">Sometimes</option><option value="0.7">Often</option><option value="1">Always</option></select></div>
      </div>
      <details class="bt-more" id="bt-rhythm-more"><summary id="bt-rhythm-more-sum">Add more rhythms</summary>
        <div class="bt-morelist" id="bt-rhythm-extra" role="group" aria-label="More comping rhythms for the band to use as well"></div></details>
      <details class="bt-more" id="bt-ext-more"><summary>Which extensions</summary>
        <div class="bt-morelist" role="group" aria-label="Unmarked extensions the comping may add">
          <label><input type="checkbox" id="bt-ext-nine" checked> 9th on 7th chords (C7 as C9, Cm7 as Cm9, Cmaj7 as Cmaj9)</label>
          <label><input type="checkbox" id="bt-ext-thirteen" checked> 13th on dominant 7ths (C7 as C13)</label>
          <label><input type="checkbox" id="bt-ext-six" checked> 6th in place of a major 7th (Cmaj7 as C6)</label>
        </div></details>
      <details class="bt-more" id="bt-voicing-more"><summary id="bt-voicing-more-sum">Add more voicings</summary>
        <div class="bt-morelist" id="bt-voicing-extra" role="group" aria-label="More voicings for the band to use as well"></div></details>
      <div class="bt-row" id="bt-second-row">
        <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-second" title="A second chord player beside the comping instrument: guitar and keys together, or two guitars. It has its own rhythm, voicings and fader, and does not change what the first one plays.">Second chord instrument</label><select id="bt-second"></select></div>
        <div class="bt-field" id="bt-second-rhythm-f" hidden><label for="bt-second-rhythm">Its rhythm</label><select id="bt-second-rhythm"></select></div>
        <div class="bt-field" id="bt-second-voicing-f" hidden><label for="bt-second-voicing">Its voicings</label><select id="bt-second-voicing"></select></div>
        <button type="button" class="bt-btn" id="bt-second-suggest" hidden title="Set its rhythm and voicings to what suits the chosen Style">Suggest for this style</button>
      </div>
      <details class="bt-info"><summary>Info</summary>
      <p class="bt-hint">The menus list what belongs in the chosen Style; hover over an entry for what it is and which styles it fits. Tick Unlock to see everything: what fits the style is listed first and the rest follows under its own headings.</p>
      <p class="bt-hint">Unmarked extensions are heard in the Standard, Drop 2 and Drop 3 voicings. Shells, guide tones, the three-string guitar shapes and open chords are fixed sets of notes and stay as they are; Rootless voicings always carry a 9th and 13th. Chords written with an alteration (C7&#9837;9, C7alt) are left alone.</p>
      <p class="bt-hint">Tick more rhythms or voicings and the band uses all of them. Ticked rhythms: the short swing figures are mixed bar by bar; the others (four to the bar, the Latin patterns, arpeggios) are kept for four bars at a time. With Rhythm on Varied, ticking rhythms limits it to just those.</p>
      </details>
    </div>
    <div class="bt-sub">
      <h3>Drums</h3>
      <div class="bt-row">
        <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-groove">Groove</label><select id="bt-groove"></select></div>
        <p class="bt-hint" style="margin:0">The cymbal and the kit faders are in the Mixer.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </details>

  <details class="bt-panel bt-fold" id="bt-sec-mix" open>
    <summary>Mixer</summary>
    <div class="bt-mixer" role="group" aria-label="Mix">
      <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-vol-bass">Bass volume</label><input type="range" id="bt-vol-bass" min="0" max="150" value="100"></div>
      <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-vol-comp" id="bt-vol-comp-label">Piano volume</label><input type="range" id="bt-vol-comp" min="0" max="150" value="100"></div>
      <div class="bt-field" hidden><label for="bt-vol-comp2" id="bt-vol-comp2-label">Second instrument volume</label><input type="range" id="bt-vol-comp2" min="0" max="150" value="80"></div>
      <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-vol-drums">Drums volume</label><input type="range" id="bt-vol-drums" min="0" max="150" value="100"></div>
    </div>
    <details class="bt-fold bt-kit" id="bt-eq">
      <summary>Tone (EQ)</summary>
      <div class="bt-row">
        <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-eq-inst">Instrument</label><select id="bt-eq-inst"></select></div>
        <button type="button" class="bt-btn" id="bt-eq-reset">Flat</button>
        <button type="button" class="bt-btn" id="bt-eq-reset-all">All instruments flat</button>
      </div>
      <div class="bt-eq" id="bt-eq-bands" role="group" aria-label="Five EQ bands"></div>
      <div id="bt-amp" hidden>
        <div class="bt-row"><span class="bt-group-label" id="bt-amp-title">Amp</span><button type="button" class="bt-btn" id="bt-amp-reset">Amp as designed</button></div>
        <div class="bt-eq" id="bt-amp-stages" role="group" aria-label="Amp stages, in the order the sound passes through them"></div>
      </div>
      <details class="bt-info"><summary>Info</summary>
      <p class="bt-hint">The clean and distorted electric guitars are the jazz guitar's samples played through an amp. When one of them is chosen above, its amp is listed under the EQ, stage by stage in the order the sound passes through: Input gain is how hard the amp is hit, Drive how much it distorts, Output level makes up the loudness afterwards. The EQ comes after the amp.</p>
      <p class="bt-hint">Five bands for each sound, remembered on this computer. Every band can be a bell (boost or cut around a frequency), a shelf (everything below or above it), or a cut (low cut removes what is below the frequency, high cut what is above; the amount does not apply). Width is how narrow the band is: low is broad, high is narrow. The settings belong to the sound, so the jazz guitar keeps its tone whatever tune or style is loaded.</p>
      </details>
    </details>
    <details class="bt-fold bt-kit" id="bt-kit" open>
      <summary>Drum kit mix</summary>
      <div class="bt-row">
        <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-ride">Cymbal</label>
          <select id="bt-ride"><option value="ride">Ride</option><option value="hat">Closed hi-hat</option><option value="bell">Ride bell</option></select></div>
        <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-ride-sound">Ride cymbal</label>
          <select id="bt-ride-sound"><option value="ride">Ride 1</option><option value="ride2">Ride 2</option></select></div>
        <button type="button" class="bt-btn" id="bt-kit-reset">Reset faders</button>
      </div>
      <div class="bt-mixer" role="group" aria-label="Drum kit mix" id="bt-kit-faders"></div>
      <details class="bt-info"><summary>Info</summary>
    <p class="bt-hint">Each fader is on top of the Drums volume. The ride and crash start low because the sampled cymbals ring loudly; Reset faders returns to those settings.</p>
    </details>
    </details>
  </details>

  <details class="bt-panel bt-fold" id="bt-practice" open>
    <summary>Practice</summary>
    <div class="bt-row">
      <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-start">Start at bar</label><input type="number" id="bt-start" min="1" value="1"></div>
      <div class="bt-field"><span class="bt-group-label">Tempo change</span>
        <div class="bt-inline">
          <label class="bt-check"><input type="checkbox" id="bt-step-on"> Each repeat</label>
          <input type="number" id="bt-step-a" min="-60" max="60" value="8" aria-label="Tempo change in beats per minute at each repeat"><span class="bt-unit">then</span>
          <input type="number" id="bt-step-b" min="-60" max="60" placeholder="same" aria-label="Optional alternating tempo change, for example minus 3"><span class="bt-unit">bpm</span>
        </div></div>
    </div>
    <details class="bt-info"><summary>Info</summary>
    <p class="bt-hint">The loop controls are in the Play panel at the top. Click a bar on the chart to start there, then press <kbd>L</kbd> and click the bar the loop should end on; <kbd>L</kbd> again turns the loop off and on. An end bar before the start loops over the end of the form (10 to 2 plays 10, 11, 12, 1, 2). With the loop on, a click moves its end and Shift-click moves its start. The second tempo box alternates with the first: 8 then -3 goes up 8, back 3, up 8, back 3. Stopping returns to the tempo you set.</p>
    </details>
  </details>

  <details class="bt-panel bt-fold" id="bt-setups">
    <summary>Save and load</summary>
    <div class="bt-row">
      <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-setup-name">Name</label><input type="text" id="bt-setup-name" maxlength="60" placeholder="e.g. Watermelon Man, slow" style="width:16rem;max-width:100%"></div>
      <button type="button" class="bt-btn" id="bt-setup-save">Save this tune and settings</button>
    </div>
    <div class="bt-row">
      <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-setup-list">Saved on this device</label><select id="bt-setup-list" style="min-width:14rem"></select></div>
      <button type="button" class="bt-btn" id="bt-setup-load">Load</button>
      <button type="button" class="bt-btn" id="bt-setup-del">Delete</button>
      <button type="button" class="bt-btn" id="bt-setup-export">Download all</button>
      <label class="bt-btn" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;margin:0">Import a file<input type="file" id="bt-setup-import" accept="application/json,.json" hidden></label>
      <button type="button" class="bt-btn" id="bt-setup-json-btn">Show JSON for the defaults</button>
    </div>
    <textarea id="bt-setup-json" readonly hidden aria-label="The selected setup as JSON" style="display:block;width:100%;min-height:8rem;margin-top:.8rem;font-family:var(--font-mono,monospace);font-size:.78rem"></textarea>
    <p class="bt-hint" id="bt-setup-note" role="status"></p>
    <details class="bt-info"><summary>Info</summary>
    <p class="bt-hint">A setup is the changes (in their key and meter) with the tempo, style and every band, mixer and loop setting. Setups are kept in this browser on this device, and they also appear at the bottom of the Changes menu. Download all saves them as a file you can import on another device. To make one a built-in for everybody, press Show JSON for the defaults and send that text to whoever maintains the site: it is pasted into <code>apps/shared/band/presets.js</code>.</p>
    </details>
  </details>

  <details class="bt-panel bt-fold" id="bt-notation">
    <summary>Notation</summary>
    <div class="bt-row">
      <label class="bt-check"><input type="checkbox" id="bt-nt-drums"> Show drums</label>
      <button type="button" class="bt-btn" id="bt-nt-refresh">Show the latest bars</button>
      <span class="bt-hint" id="bt-nt-which" role="status" style="margin:0"></span>
    </div>
    <div class="bt-score" id="bt-score"></div>
    <details class="bt-info"><summary>Info</summary>
    <p class="bt-hint" id="bt-nt-hint">While the band plays, this shows the chorus you are about to hear: it is drawn before the chorus starts (during the count-in for the first one, and during the last bar of each chorus for the next) and stays while that chorus plays. Change a band setting and the bars not yet played are written again. With "Each repeat" tempo steps on, it shows the last chorus played instead. The piano is on a grand staff, with the bass clef holding what the left hand plays. Swung eighths are written as plain eighths; in 6/8 and 12/8 each beat is three written eighths. The bass is written an octave above where it sounds, and note lengths are rounded to eighths.</p>
    </details>
  </details>

  <details class="bt-panel bt-fold" id="bt-export">
    <summary>Export MIDI</summary>
    <div class="bt-row">
      <label class="bt-check"><input type="checkbox" id="bt-mid-bass" checked> Bass</label>
      <label class="bt-check"><input type="checkbox" id="bt-mid-comp" checked> Comping</label>
      <label class="bt-check"><input type="checkbox" id="bt-mid-drums" checked> Drums</label>
      <div class="bt-field"><label for="bt-mid-range">Bars</label>
        <select id="bt-mid-range"><option value="chorus">Last full chorus</option><option value="last">Last N bars</option><option value="all">Everything played</option></select></div>
      <div class="bt-field" id="bt-mid-n-field" hidden><label for="bt-mid-n">N</label><input type="number" id="bt-mid-n" min="1" max="999" step="1" value="12"></div>
      <button type="button" class="bt-btn" id="bt-mid-go">Download .mid</button>
    </div>
    <p class="bt-hint" id="bt-mid-note" role="status">Exports the notes the band actually played, with the swing written into the timing. If nothing has been played yet, the bars are generated fresh with the current settings.</p>
  </details>

  <details class="bt-panel bt-abc">
    <summary>Edit the changes (ABC)</summary>
    <div class="bt-row"><button type="button" class="bt-btn" id="bt-to-entry" title="Opens the Chord Entry page with these changes and voicings. Play chords or voicings in there, then send them back.">Enter chords or voicings from a keyboard</button></div>
    <textarea id="bt-abc" spellcheck="false" autocapitalize="off" autocomplete="off" aria-label="Changes as ABC" aria-describedby="bt-abc-hint"></textarea>
    <details class="bt-info"><summary>Info</summary>
    <p class="bt-hint" id="bt-abc-hint">The chord symbols in quotes are what the band reads. Where a symbol sits in the bar sets the beat it lands on, so <code>"Cm7"z2 "F7"z2</code> gives each chord two beats. The rests only fill out the bar. A line such as <code>P:Verse</code> or <code>P:Chorus</code> names the section that starts at the next bar: the drummer fills into each one, a section called Chorus is played up, and the Sections menu by the Play button can hold each section until you press Next. <code>"^fill"</code> (or <code>"^small fill"</code>, <code>"^big fill"</code>) in a bar makes the drummer fill at the end of it, and <code>"^stop"</code> makes it a stop-time bar; a line <code>%%style bossa nova</code> under a <code>P:</code> line plays that section in another style from the Style menu, and single parts can follow it, as in <code>%%style Swing; voicing drop2; rhythm charleston; bass two</code> (in a bar, <code>"^style bossa nova"</code> does the same from there to the next section); the Fill on bar and Stop on bar boxes write these for you. The <code>M:</code> line sets the meter: the band plays 3/4 as a jazz waltz and counts 6/8 and 12/8 in dotted quarters.</p>
    </details>
    <p class="bt-hint bt-warn" id="bt-abc-note" role="status"></p>
  </details>
</div>

<script src="/apps/shared/band/catalog.js?v=26"></script>

<script src="/apps/shared/band/sounds.js?v=9"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/band/player.js?v=113"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/band/midi.js?v=14"></script>
<script src="/apps/shared/band/notation.js?v=6"></script>
<script>
(function(){
  var $ = function(id){ return document.getElementById(id); };
  var statusEl = $("bt-status"), playBtn = $("bt-play");
  function setStatus(msg, isError){ statusEl.textContent = msg || ""; statusEl.classList.toggle("is-error", !!isError); }
  if (typeof TuneChart === "undefined" || typeof BandPlayer === "undefined" || typeof BandHarmony === "undefined"){
    setStatus("The band didn't load. Reload the page to try again.", true); playBtn.disabled = true; return;
  }

  // ---- the changes: plain ABC. The band reads the quoted chord symbols and where they
  // sit in the bar; the rests only fill each bar. Written in F, transposed by the Key menu.
  var KEYS = ["C","Db","D","Eb","E","F","Gb","G","Ab","A","Bb","B"];
  // Each preset is its bars (one or two chords each); the Meter menu decides how they are written.
  // `one` = rest lengths for a whole bar, `two` = for a bar shared by two chords. In 6/8 and 12/8
  // the band counts dotted quarters, so the tempo is dotted quarters per minute.
  var METERS = [
    { id:"4/4",  label:"4/4",  L:"1/4", one:"4",  two:["2","2"], tempo:120 },
    { id:"3/4",  label:"3/4",  L:"1/4", one:"3",  two:["2",""],  tempo:132 },
    { id:"6/8",  label:"6/8",  L:"1/8", one:"6",  two:["3","3"], tempo:72 },
    { id:"12/8", label:"12/8", L:"1/8", one:"12", two:["6","6"], tempo:60 }
  ];
  function meterDef(id){ return METERS.filter(function(m){ return m.id === id; })[0] || null; }
  var PRESETS = [
    { id:"basic", label:"Basic blues", title:"Basic Blues", bars:"F7|F7|F7|F7|Bb7|Bb7|F7|F7|C7|Bb7|F7|C7" },
    { id:"quick", label:"Quick-change blues", title:"Quick-Change Blues", bars:"F7|Bb7|F7|F7|Bb7|Bb7|F7|F7|C7|Bb7|F7|C7" },
    { id:"jazz", label:"Jazz blues", title:"Jazz Blues", bars:"F7|Bb7|F7|Cm7 F7|Bb7|Bdim7|F7|Am7 D7|Gm7|C7|F7 D7|Gm7 C7" },
    // the 16-bar blues of Watermelon Man: straight eighths, the riff bass, and a stop on bar 14.
    // `style` = the band style the preset picks; `stops` = bars the band stops on.
    { id:"watermelon", label:"Watermelon Man (16 bars)", title:"Watermelon Man changes", bars:"F7|F7|F7|F7|Bb7|Bb7|F7|F7|C7|Bb7|C7|Bb7|C7|Bb7|F7|F7",
      stops:"14", tempo:132, style:"boogaloo" }
  ];
  function presetAbc(p, meterId){
    var m = meterDef(meterId) || METERS[0], bars = p.bars.split("|").map(function(b){
      var c = b.split(" ");
      return c.length > 1 ? '"' + c[0] + '"z' + m.two[0] + ' "' + c[1] + '"z' + m.two[1] : '"' + c[0] + '"z' + m.one; });
    var lines = []; for (var i = 0; i < bars.length; i += 4) lines.push(bars.slice(i, i + 4).join(" | ") + (i + 4 >= bars.length ? " |]" : " |"));
    return "X:1\nT:" + p.title + "\nM:" + m.id + "\nL:" + m.L + "\nK:F\n" + lines.join("\n");
  }
  // Comping instruments. The voicing styles each offers come from BandHarmony.styleList, which asks
  // the shared ChordVoicings library (and falls back to the band's own list if it did not load).
  // The sounds come from BandSounds (sounds.js): every sound of the piano family, then every guitar. A new sound there appears here.
  var COMPING = ["piano", "guitar"].reduce(function (list, fam){
    return list.concat(BandSounds.sounds(fam).map(function (x){
      var c = { id: x.id, label: x.label, name: fam === "guitar" ? "Guitar" : x.id === "organ" ? "Organ" : x.label, inst: fam };
      if (x.id !== fam) c.sound = x.id;                            // the instrument's voicings, another sound
      return c; })); }, []);
  // Bass lines and comping rhythms: names and descriptions live in the shared catalog, which the
  // Accompaniment Styles page lists too.
  var CAT = window.BandCatalog || { bass: [{ id:"walk", label:"Walking" }, { id:"two", label:"Two-feel" }], comp: [{ id:"auto", label:"Varied" }] };

  // ---- the chart can be written for a transposing instrument (display only) ----
  // B-flat instruments read a major 2nd above concert, E-flat instruments a major 6th above. The key
  // names are the usual ones (F# not Gb, Db not C#); AbcTranspose then spells every chord for that key.
  var WRITTEN = {
    bb: { semis: 2, short: "B♭ instruments", maj: ["D","Eb","E","F","F#","G","Ab","A","Bb","B","C","Db"], min: ["D","Eb","E","F","F#","G","G#","A","Bb","B","C","C#"] },
    eb: { semis: 9, short: "E♭ instruments", maj: ["A","Bb","B","C","Db","D","Eb","E","F","F#","G","Ab"], min: ["A","Bb","B","C","C#","D","Eb","E","F","F#","G","G#"] }
  };
  function isMinorKey(keyField){ return /^[A-Ga-g][#b]?\s*(m|min|minor|aeo|aeolian)\b/i.test(keyField || ""); }
  function writtenKeyName(keyField, keyPc, family){
    var w = WRITTEN[family]; if (!w) return null;
    return (isMinorKey(keyField) ? w.min : w.maj)[keyPc];
  }
  function flatGlyph(name){ return String(name).replace(/b/g, "♭").replace(/#/g, "♯"); }
  // the chart's text for a given family: { abc, note } (concert pitch: the ABC as it is, no note)
  function chartView(concertAbc, parsed, family){
    var w = WRITTEN[family], key;
    if (!w || typeof AbcTranspose === "undefined" || !(key = writtenKeyName(parsed.keyField, parsed.keyPc, family))) return { abc: concertAbc, note: "" };
    var text = concertAbc; try { text = AbcTranspose.transpose(concertAbc, key); } catch (e) { return { abc: concertAbc, note: "" }; }
    return { abc: text, note: w.short + " · concert " + flatGlyph((parsed.keyField || "").trim()) };
  }

  // ---- state ----
  // `abc` / `parsedC` are the changes in CONCERT pitch: what the band, the notation and the MIDI file read.
  // `chart` shows them (maybe re-written for a transposing instrument); its bars line up with parsedC's.
  var abc = "", parsedC = null, chart = null, player = null, state = "idle", liveSrc = -1, editTimer = null, beatEls = [], baseBeats = 4;
  var remote = { on: /[?&]remote=1/.test(location.search) && !!window.opener, origin: null, melody: null, mute: false };   // driven by the page that opened this one (see "remote" below)
  var pins = null;                       // pinned voicings handed over by Chord Sheet: { map:{"idx:pos":midis}, count }

  function hasChords(parsed){ return parsed.bars.some(function(b){ return b.chords.some(function(c){ return !c.nc; }); }); }
  function buildBeats(n){
    var box = $("bt-beats"); if (beatEls.length === n) return;
    box.innerHTML = ""; beatEls = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++){ var d = document.createElement("i"); box.appendChild(d); beatEls.push(d); }
  }
  function showBeat(b){ beatEls.forEach(function(el, i){ el.classList.toggle("on", i === b); }); }
  function showLive(src){ liveSrc = src; var shown = tabFollow(src); if (chart) chart.setLive(shown); }

  // Parse + show a new set of changes; hand them to the band (takes effect from its next bar).
  function applyAbc(text, fromEditor, allowEmpty){
    var parsed = null; try { parsed = TuneChart.parse(text); } catch (e) {}
    if (!parsed || !(allowEmpty ? parsed.bars.length : hasChords(parsed))){
      $("bt-abc-note").textContent = 'No chord symbols found yet. Put each one in quotes before its beat, like "F7"z4.';
      return false;
    }
    $("bt-abc-note").textContent = "";
    abc = text; parsedC = parsed; parsedC.asWritten = $("bt-aswritten").checked;
    remoteTune();
    showChart(); barCheck(); abcSettings(text, parsed);
    secCheck(); marksToFields(); sectionsSync();
    $("bt-key").value = KEYS[parsed.keyPc];
    showMeter(parsed);
    if (!fromEditor) $("bt-abc").value = text;
    if (player) player.setChart(parsedC);
    practiceSync();
    sideIdle();
    if (remote && remote.on && remote.loaded){                  // the lyrics page relabels the chords over its words
      if (fromEditor){ remote.version = null; remoteVersionShow(); }
      remoteSay({ type: "bt-abc", abc: text, version: remote.version });
    }
    return true;
  }
  // Stops and fills live in the ABC ("^stop", "^fill"). The two boxes show them, in the band's bar numbers, and write them back.
  var marksFromField = false;
  function formOf(){ return parsedC ? BandHarmony.buildForm(parsedC, 0) : []; }
  function marksToFields(){
    if (marksFromField) return;
    var stops = [], fills = [], seen = {};
    formOf().forEach(function(b, i){ if (seen[b.src]) return; seen[b.src] = 1;                 // (a repeated bar is named once, by its first time round)
      if (b.stop) stops.push(i + 1); if (b.fill) fills.push((i + 1) + (b.fill === "small" ? " small" : b.fill === "large" ? " big" : "")); });
    $("bt-stops").value = stops.join(", "); $("bt-fillbars").value = fills.join(", ");
  }
  // "8, 16 big, 12s" -> { form bar index: size }
  function fillBarsField(){ var out = {}; $("bt-fillbars").value.replace(/(\d+)\s*([a-z]*)/gi, function(_, n, w){ n = parseInt(n, 10) - 1; if (n >= 0) out[n] = /^(s|sm|small|short)$/i.test(w) ? "small" : /^(b|big|l|large|long)$/i.test(w) ? "large" : "medium"; }); return out; }
  function fieldsToAbc(){
    if (!parsedC) return;
    var form = formOf(), stops = [], fills = {}, fb = fillBarsField();
    stopBars().forEach(function(i){ if (form[i]) stops.push(form[i].src); });
    Object.keys(fb).forEach(function(i){ if (form[i]) fills[form[i].src] = fb[i]; });
    var text = TuneChart.setMarks(abc, { stops: stops, fills: fills }); if (text === abc) return;
    marksFromField = true; try { applyAbc(text, false); } finally { marksFromField = false; }
  }
  // The chart's sections (P: lines): the Sections controls appear, and a section called Chorus or Refrain is played up like the Chorus bars.
  function chartSections(){ var out = [], any = false; formOf().forEach(function(b, i){ if (b.section != null) any = true;
    if (b.section != null || !out.length) out.push({ name: b.section || "", from: i, to: i }); else out[out.length - 1].to = i; }); return any ? out : []; }
  function chorusBars(){ var out = []; chartSections().forEach(function(sc){ if (/^(chorus|refrain)\b/i.test(sc.name)) for (var i = sc.from; i <= sc.to; i++) out.push(i); }); return out; }
  function sectionsSync(){
    var has = chartSections().length > 0; $("bt-sections-field").hidden = !has;
    if (player){ player.setHold(has && $("bt-hold").value === "hold"); player.setOpts(bandOpts()); }
    liveButtons();
  }
  function liveButtons(){ var on = state === "playing"; $("bt-fill").disabled = !on; $("bt-next").disabled = !on || $("bt-hold").value !== "hold"; if (!on) $("bt-secname").textContent = ""; }
  // Bars that do not add up to their meter: say which, and how the band takes them (a full bar, unless "as written" is ticked).
  function barCheck(){
    var iss = TuneChart.check(parsedC), box = $("bt-barwarn"); box.hidden = !iss.length; if (!iss.length) return;
    function b(n){ return n + (n === 1 ? " beat" : " beats"); }
    var asW = $("bt-aswritten").checked, parts = iss.slice(0, 6).map(function(x){ return "bar " + x.measureNo + " (" + x.meter + ") holds " + b(x.have); });
    $("bt-barwarn-text").textContent = (iss.length === 1 ? "Check the ABC: " : "Check the ABC: " + iss.length + " bars do not add up. ") + parts.join("; ") + (iss.length > 6 ? "; and more" : "") + ". " +
      (asW ? "The band plays " + (iss.length === 1 ? "it" : "them") + " exactly as written." : "The band plays " + (iss.length === 1 ? "it as a full bar" : "each as a full bar") + " of its meter.");
  }
  // What the ABC itself asks for: a tempo (Q:78, Q:1/4=78) and a style (%%style emo, or the style's name). Each is taken when it
  // appears or changes in the ABC; after that the controls at the top are free to override it.
  var abcQ = null, abcStyle = null, booted = false;
  function abcSettings(text, parsed){
    var q = /^Q:\s*(?:"[^"]*"\s*)?(?:(\d+)\/(\d+)\s*=\s*)?(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/m.exec(text), bpm = null;
    if (q){ var mi = BandHarmony.meterInfo(parsed.meterN, parsed.meterD), beat = mi.per / parsed.meterD;      // the beat the Tempo box counts, in whole notes
      bpm = Math.round(parseFloat(q[3]) * (q[1] ? (parseInt(q[1], 10) / parseInt(q[2], 10)) / beat : 1)); }
    var body = text.search(/^K:.*$/m), firstP = body < 0 ? -1 : text.slice(body).search(/^P:\s*\S/m);
    var sm = /^%%\s*style\s+(.+?)\s*$/m.exec(firstP < 0 ? text : text.slice(0, body + firstP)), sid = null;      // (a %%style under a P: line is that section's own)
    if (sm){ var want = sm[1].toLowerCase(); BandCatalog.styles.forEach(function(s){ if (!sid && (s.id.toLowerCase() === want || s.label.toLowerCase() === want)) sid = s.id; });
      if (!sid) BandCatalog.styles.forEach(function(s){ if (!sid && s.label.toLowerCase().indexOf(want) >= 0) sid = s.id; }); }
    var own = [], bad = [], sname = "";
    formOf().forEach(function(b){ if (b.section != null) sname = b.section; if (!b.style || own.some(function(x){ return x[0] === sname && x[1] === b.style; })) return; own.push([sname, b.style]);
      if (!BandCatalog.sectionOpts(b.style, {})) bad.push(b.style.split(";")[0].trim()); });
    $("bt-abc-note").textContent = sm && !sid ? 'No style called "' + sm[1] + '". Use a name from the Style menu, for example %%style Piano ballad.'
      : bad.length ? 'No style called "' + bad[0] + '". A section keeps the main style until its %%style line names one from the Style menu.'
      : own.length ? "Sections in a style of their own: " + own.map(function(x){ return (x[0] || "from a bar") + " (" + x[1] + ")"; }).join(", ") + ". The menus above set the rest." : "";
    if (!booted) return;                                   // (taken once the page is set up: see the end of the script)
    if (bpm !== abcQ){ abcQ = bpm; if (bpm){ $("bt-tempo-n").value = bpm; var t = tempo(); $("bt-tempo-n").value = t; $("bt-tempo").value = t; if (player) player.setTempo(t); } }
    if (sid !== abcStyle){ abcStyle = sid; if (sid && $("bt-style").value !== sid){ $("bt-style").value = sid; $("bt-style").dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true })); } }
  }
  // draw the chart: concert pitch or written for the chosen instrument, letters and/or Roman numerals.
  // The numerals follow the chart's own key, so they read the same in every transposition.
  function showChart(){
    var view = chartView(abc, parsedC, $("bt-chartfor").value), vp = null;
    try { vp = TuneChart.parse(view.abc); } catch (e) {}
    if (!vp || vp.bars.length !== parsedC.bars.length){ vp = parsedC; view.note = ""; }
    if (chart){ chart.setKeyNote(view.note); chart.setRoman($("bt-roman").value); chart.setTune(vp); chart.setLive(liveSrc); }
    else chart = TuneChart.render($("bt-chart"), vp, { header:true, preferFlats:true, roman:$("bt-roman").value, romanFn:BandHarmony.roman, keyNote:view.note });
    $("bt-chartfor-hint").hidden = !view.note;
    chartTabs();
  }
  // A chart with sections (P: lines) is shown on tabs, like a tabset. Three views (the menu at the end of the strip, remembered):
  //   "unique"  one tab for each DIFFERENT section: a section that comes round again with the same bars shares the tab of its first time,
  //             so a song is Verse / Chorus / Bridge however often they are played (same name, other bars: "Verse 2");
  //   "order"   one tab for every section in the order it is played;
  //   "all"     the whole chart, no tabs.
  // The tab follows the band while it plays. tabSel: index of the tab shown.
  var tabSel = 0, tabLive = -1, tabLiveSec = -1;
  function tabView(){ return $("bt-tabview").value; }
  function tabSections(){
    var out = []; if (!parsedC) return out;
    parsedC.bars.forEach(function(b, i){ if (b.section != null) out.push({ name: b.section || "Section " + (out.length + 1), bar: i }); });
    out.forEach(function(sc, k){ sc.end = k + 1 < out.length ? out[k + 1].bar : parsedC.bars.length;
      sc.key = sc.name.toLowerCase() + "|" + parsedC.bars.slice(sc.bar, sc.end).map(function(b){ return b.chords.map(function(c){ return c.onset + c.sym; }).join(" ") + (b.fill || "") + (b.stop ? "!" : ""); }).join("|"); });
    return out;
  }
  // the tabs of the view: [{ name, secs: [section indexes], first }]
  function tabList(secs){
    if (tabView() === "order") return secs.map(function(sc, k){ return { name: sc.name, secs: [k], first: k }; });
    var groups = [], byKey = {}, count = {};
    secs.forEach(function(sc, k){ var g = byKey[sc.key];
      if (!g){ count[sc.name] = (count[sc.name] || 0) + 1; g = byKey[sc.key] = { name: sc.name + (count[sc.name] > 1 ? " " + count[sc.name] : ""), secs: [], first: k }; groups.push(g); }
      g.secs.push(k); });
    return groups;
  }
  function tabOf(secs, bar){ var k = 0; secs.forEach(function(sc, i){ if (sc.bar <= bar) k = i; }); return k; }
  function tabIndex(tabs, k){ for (var i = 0; i < tabs.length; i++) if (tabs[i].secs.indexOf(k) >= 0) return i; return -1; }
  // The tabset is a real one, built inside the chart under its title: Bootstrap's own markup (ul.nav.nav-tabs > li.nav-item > a.nav-link,
  // div.tab-content > div.tab-pane), as Quarto writes for a .panel-tabset, so it looks and behaves like every other tabset on the site.
  // Each pane holds the rows of its section; rows that belong to no pane (a repeat of a section, in the one-tab-per-section view) wait in
  // the chart's own, hidden, list. The chart redraws itself for several reasons, so this is rebuilt whenever its rows are new.
  // Under each pane, one line of what comes next: the name of the section that follows and its chords, bar by bar.
  // k = the section (in playing order) whose successor is wanted.
  function nextLine(secs, k){
    var nx = secs[k + 1]; if (!nx) return { name: "End", text: "" };
    var bars = parsedC.bars.slice(nx.bar, nx.end).map(function(b){ return b.chords.length ? b.chords.map(function(c){ return c.nc ? "N.C." : TuneChart.fmtChord ? c.sym.replace(/b/g, "\u266d").replace(/#/g, "\u266f") : c.sym; }).join(" ") : "\u00b7"; });
    return { name: nx.name, text: bars.join("  |  ") };
  }
  function tabNext(pane, secs, k){
    var el = pane.querySelector(".bt-next-line"); if (!el) return; var n = nextLine(secs, k);
    el.querySelector("b").textContent = "Next: " + n.name; el.querySelector("span").textContent = n.text; el.title = n.text ? n.name + ": " + n.text : "";
  }
  var tabBusy = false;
  function tabShow(i){
    var set = $("bt-chart").querySelector(".bt-tabset"); if (!set) return;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(set.querySelectorAll(".nav-link"), function(a, k){ a.classList.toggle("active", k === i); a.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(k === i)); a.tabIndex = k === i ? 0 : -1; a.classList.toggle("is-live", k === tabLive); });
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(set.querySelectorAll(".tab-pane"), function(p, k){ p.classList.toggle("active", k === i); p.classList.toggle("show", k === i); });
  }
  function chartTabs(){
    if (tabBusy) return; tabBusy = true;
    try {
      var root = $("bt-chart"), sys = root.querySelector(".tc-systems:not(.bt-pane-rows)"); if (!sys) return;
      var secs = tabSections(), on = secs.length > 1, all = tabView() === "all";
      $("bt-tabstrip").hidden = !on;
      var tabs = on && !all ? tabList(secs) : []; if (tabSel >= tabs.length) tabSel = 0;
      // every row back in the chart's own list, in its order
      var rows = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll(".tc-system"));
      rows.forEach(function(r, i){ if (!r.hasAttribute("data-row")) r.setAttribute("data-row", sys.contains(r) ? String(i) : "9999"); });
      rows.sort(function(x, y){ return (+x.getAttribute("data-row")) - (+y.getAttribute("data-row")); }).forEach(function(r, i){ r.setAttribute("data-row", i); r.hidden = false; sys.appendChild(r); });
      var old = root.querySelector(".bt-tabset"); if (old) old.remove();
      sys.hidden = false;
      if (!tabs.length) return;
      var set = document.createElement("div"); set.className = "panel-tabset bt-tabset";
      var nav = document.createElement("ul"); nav.className = "nav nav-tabs"; nav.setAttribute("role", "tablist");
      var content = document.createElement("div"); content.className = "tab-content";
      tabs.forEach(function(t, i){
        var li = document.createElement("li"); li.className = "nav-item"; li.setAttribute("role", "presentation");
        var a = document.createElement("a"); a.className = "nav-link"; a.href = "#bt-pane-" + i; a.id = "bt-tab-" + i; a.setAttribute("role", "tab"); a.setAttribute("aria-controls", "bt-pane-" + i); a.textContent = t.name;
        a.addEventListener("click", function(e){ e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); tabSel = i; tabShow(i); });
        a.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){ var d = e.key === "ArrowRight" ? 1 : e.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -1 : 0; if (!d) return;       // arrow keys move along the tabs
          e.preventDefault(); tabSel = (i + d + tabs.length) % tabs.length; tabShow(tabSel); nav.querySelectorAll(".nav-link")[tabSel].focus(); });
        li.appendChild(a); nav.appendChild(li);
        var pane = document.createElement("div"); pane.className = "tab-pane"; pane.id = "bt-pane-" + i; pane.setAttribute("role", "tabpanel"); pane.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", a.id); pane.setAttribute("data-print-title", t.name);
        var list = document.createElement("div"); list.className = "tc-systems bt-pane-rows"; pane.appendChild(list); content.appendChild(pane);
        var nl = document.createElement("div"); nl.className = "bt-next-line"; nl.appendChild(document.createElement("b")); nl.appendChild(document.createElement("span")); pane.appendChild(nl);
        tabNext(pane, secs, t.first);
        rows.forEach(function(r){ var first = r.querySelector(".tc-bar[data-bar]"); if (first && tabOf(secs, parseInt(first.getAttribute("data-bar"), 10)) === t.first) list.appendChild(r); });
      });
      set.appendChild(nav); set.appendChild(content); sys.parentNode.insertBefore(set, sys);
      sys.hidden = true;                                           // (what is left there is a repeat of something on a tab)
      tabShow(tabSel);
    } finally { tabBusy = false; }
  }
  // The bar now sounding (its written bar, or -1): turn to its tab, and say which bar of the chart to light. Where a repeated section
  // shares the tab of its first time, that is the same bar of the first time.
  function tabFollow(src){
    var secs = tabSections(), tabs = secs.length > 1 && tabView() !== "all" ? tabList(secs) : [], k = src >= 0 && tabs.length ? tabOf(secs, src) : -1;
    var t = k >= 0 ? tabIndex(tabs, k) : -1, shown = src;
    if (t >= 0 && tabs[t].first !== k) shown = secs[tabs[t].first].bar + (src - secs[k].bar);
    if (t !== tabLive){ tabLive = t; if (t >= 0) tabSel = t; tabShow(tabSel); }

    if (bars) what = "as played";
```
