    if (parts.indexOf("comp") >= 0 && bars.some(function(x){ return x.parts && x.parts.comp2 && x.parts.comp2.length; })) parts.splice(parts.indexOf("comp") + 1, 0, "comp2");   // the second chord instrument goes with the first
    var bytes = BandMidi.build(bars, { parts: parts });
    var name = (parsedC.title || "backing-track").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/^-|-$/g, "") + "-" + keyField() + "-" + Math.round(bars[0].tempo) + "bpm.mid";
    var a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes], { type: "audio/midi" })); a.download = name;
    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove(); setTimeout(function(){ URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); }, 2000);
    window.__btLastMidi = bytes;                                         // for tests
    note.textContent = "Saved " + name + ": " + bars.length + " bars, " + parts.join(" + ") + " (" + what + ").";
  }

  // ---- pinned voicings (from Chord Sheet) and the hand-off both ways ----
  // Chord Sheet leaves { v:1, from:"chord-sheet", at, abc, comp, voicing, pins:[{ bar, pos, sym, midis }] } in
  // localStorage.bandHandoff and opens this page with ?from=chord-sheet. The pins reach the band as opts.pins.
  var HANDOFF_MAX_AGE = 10 * 60 * 1000;
  function pinNote(text, withClear, info){
    $("bt-pinnote-text").textContent = text; $("bt-pin-clear").hidden = !withClear;
    $("bt-pinnote").classList.toggle("is-info", !!info); $("bt-pinnote").hidden = false;
  }
  var pinAuto = {};                       // voicings that were copied to a chord, not played in for it (kept so a setup or hand-off round-trips)
  // every place a chord starts, in the order the band plays them: { key: "form bar:beat", bar, pos, src, chord }
  function chordSlots(){
    var out = []; if (!parsedC) return out;
    BandHarmony.buildForm(parsedC, 0).forEach(function(fb, i){ (fb.chords || []).forEach(function(c){ if (c.chord && !c.chord.nc) out.push({ key: i + ":" + c.pos, bar: i, pos: c.pos, src: fb.src, chord: c.chord }); }); });
    return out;
  }
  // voicings as { "form bar:beat": midis } (a saved setup, or the Chord Entry page): keep the ones that still sit on a chord
  function pinsFromMap(m, autoKeys){
    var ok = {}, map = {}, n = 0; chordSlots().forEach(function(o){ ok[o.key] = 1; });
    Object.keys(m || {}).forEach(function(k){ var v = m[k]; if (ok[k] && Array.isArray(v) && v.length && v.every(function(x){ return isFinite(x) && x >= 0 && x <= 127; })){ map[k] = v.slice(); n++; } });
    setPins(map, n, true); pinAuto = {}; (autoKeys || []).forEach(function(k){ if (map[k]) pinAuto[k] = 1; });
    return n;
  }
  function setPins(map, count, mine){
    pins = count ? { map: map, count: count, mine: !!mine } : null;
    if (player) player.setOpts(bandOpts());
    if (pins) pinNote("Playing " + (mine ? "the voicings you played in" : "the voicings pinned in Chord Sheet") + " (" + count + " chord" + (count === 1 ? "" : "s") + "). Chords without one use the Voicings menu.", true, false);
    else $("bt-pinnote").hidden = true;
    sideIdle();
  }
  // pins are fixed pitches, so they stop applying once the key or the changes move
  function clearPins(why){
    if (!pins) return;
    pins = null; pinAuto = {}; if (player) player.setOpts(bandOpts());
    pinNote(why ? "Pinned voicings cleared because " + why + ". The band is choosing its own voicings again." : "Pinned voicings cleared. The band is choosing its own voicings again.", false, true);
    sideIdle();
  }
  function readHandoff(){
    var raw = null, h = null;
    try { raw = localStorage.getItem("bandHandoff"); h = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null; } catch (e) { h = null; }
    if (!h || (h.from !== "chord-sheet" && h.from !== "chord-entry")) return null;
    try { localStorage.removeItem("bandHandoff"); } catch (e) {}
    if (h.v !== 1 || typeof h.abc !== "string" || !(Date.now() - h.at < HANDOFF_MAX_AGE) || !(h.at - Date.now() < HANDOFF_MAX_AGE)) return { stale: true };
    return h;
  }
  // Links from the Accompaniment Styles page preselect the band: ?bass=riff&rhythm=charleston&feel=straight&comp=guitar
  function applyQuery(){
    var q = {}; location.search.replace(/[?&]([a-z]+)=([^&]*)/g, function(_, k, v){ q[k] = decodeURIComponent(v); });
    function pick(id, v){ var el = $(id); if (v && Array.prototype.some.call(el.options, function(o){ return o.value === v; })){ el.value = v; return true; } return false; }
    var any = false;
    if (pick("bt-comp", q.comp)){ rebuild(false); any = true; }
    if (q.style && STYLES.some(function(x){ return x.id === q.style; })){ setStyle(q.style); any = true;
      if (q.comp === "piano" || q.comp === "guitar"){ styleSounds(styleDef(), q.comp); rebuild(false); } }      // (the link's instrument, in the style's sound)
    // a link to one bass line, rhythm or groove opens the first style it belongs in, with that entry chosen
    [["bass", "bt-bass", CAT.bass], ["rhythm", "bt-rhythm", CAT.comp], ["drums", "bt-groove", DRUMS]].forEach(function(p){
      var it = q[p[0]] && p[2].filter(function(x){ return x.id === q[p[0]]; })[0]; if (!it) return;
      if (!fitsNow(it) && it.fits && it.fits.length) setStyle(it.fits[0]);
      if (p[0] === "rhythm") setRhythm(it.id); else pick(p[1], it.id);
      any = true; });
    if (q.feel && q.feel !== $("bt-feel").value && !q.style){ if (!allowedFeel(q.feel)) $("bt-unlock").checked = true; rebuild(false); pick("bt-feel", q.feel); any = true; }
    if (any){ player.setInstruments(neededSounds()); player.setOpts(bandOpts()); }
  }
  function allowedFeel(f){ return unlocked() || styleDef().feel === f; }
  function loadHandoff(){
    var q = /[?&]from=(chord-sheet|chord-entry)(&|$)/.exec(location.search); if (!q) return;
    var h = readHandoff();
    try { history.replaceState(null, "", location.pathname + location.hash); } catch (e) {}
    if (!h) return;
    if (h.stale || !applyAbc(h.abc, false)){
      pinNote("The voicings from Chord Sheet didn't come through (they expire after ten minutes). Send them again from Chord Sheet.", false, true); return; }
    $("bt-changes").value = "custom";
    if (h.from === "chord-entry"){                                        // changes (and maybe voicings) played in on the Chord Entry page
      if (h.style && STYLES.some(function(x){ return x.id === h.style; })){ $("bt-unlock").checked = false; setStyle(h.style); player.setInstruments(neededSounds()); }
      if (h.tempo){ $("bt-tempo-n").value = h.tempo; var bpm = tempo(); $("bt-tempo-n").value = bpm; $("bt-tempo").value = bpm; player.setTempo(bpm); }
      var nv = pinsFromMap(h.pinMap, h.pinsAuto);
      if (!nv) pinNote("Loaded the changes from Chord Entry.", false, true);
      player.setOpts(bandOpts()); return;
    }
    $("bt-comp").value = h.comp === "guitar" ? "guitar" : "piano";
    // voicings pinned in Chord Sheet may be ones the current style does not offer: unlock rather than drop them
    if (!allowed(voicingItems(compDef().inst), h.voicing)) $("bt-unlock").checked = true;
    rebuild(false);
    if (h.comp === "guitar" && fitsNow({ fits: CAT.comp.filter(function(x){ return x.id === "four"; })[0].fits })) setRhythm("four");
    syncVoicings(h.voicing);
    var list = (h.pins || []).filter(function(p){ return p && isFinite(p.bar) && isFinite(p.pos) && Array.isArray(p.midis) && p.midis.length &&
      p.midis.every(function(m){ return isFinite(m) && m >= 0 && m <= 127; }); });
    var map = BandHarmony.pinMap(BandHarmony.buildForm(parsedC, 0), list);
    setPins(map, Object.keys(map).length);
    if (!pins) pinNote("Loaded the changes from Chord Sheet. None of its pinned voicings matched a chord, so the band chooses its own.", false, true);
    player.setInstruments(neededSounds());
    player.setOpts(bandOpts());
  }
  // the most recent complete chorus as the band played it (or one generated now), handed to Chord Sheet
  function sendToChordSheet(){
    var note = $("bt-send-note"), bars = lastChorus(), what = "from the last chorus played", cur = bandOpts();
    // what was played with other comping settings is not what the menus say now: voice the changes afresh
    if (bars && bars.some(function(r){ var o = r.opts || {}; return o.comp !== cur.comp || o.voicing !== cur.voicing || JSON.stringify(o.extend || null) !== JSON.stringify(cur.extend || null); })){
      bars = null; what = "voiced with the current settings (they changed since the last chorus)"; }
    if (!bars){ var regen = what; bars = freshBars((parsedC.playOrder || parsedC.bars).length); what = regen !== "from the last chorus played" ? regen : "from a chorus generated with the current settings"; }
    var o = bars[0].opts || bandOpts(), inst = o.comp === "guitar" ? "guitar" : "piano";
    var style = BandHarmony.hasStyle(inst, o.voicing) ? o.voicing : BandHarmony.defaultStyle(inst);
    var seen = {}, chords = BandHarmony.asPlayed(bars, { style: style, inst: inst }).filter(function(c){     // each different chord once
      if (seen[c.sym]) return false; seen[c.sym] = 1; return true; }).map(function(c){ var e = { sym: c.sym, midis: c.midis }; if (c.strings) e.strings = c.strings; return e; });
    var payload = { v: 1, from: "backing-track", at: Date.now(), key: keyField(), comp: inst, voicing: style, chords: chords };
    try { localStorage.setItem("bandHandoff", JSON.stringify(payload)); }
    catch (e) { note.textContent = "Couldn't pass the voicings on: this browser is blocking storage for the page."; return; }
    window.__btLastHandoff = payload;                                    // for tests
    note.textContent = "Sent " + chords.length + " different chords " + what + " to Chord Sheet.";
    if (!window.open("/tools/chord-sheet.html?from=backing-track", "_blank")) location.href = "/tools/chord-sheet.html?from=backing-track";
  }

  // ---- the band ----
  function onState(s){
    state = s; playBtn.setAttribute("data-state", s);
    playBtn.innerHTML = s === "playing" ? "&#9632; Stop" : s === "loading" ? "Loading&hellip;" : "&#9654; Play";
    if (s === "idle"){ showLive(-1); buildBeats(baseBeats); showBeat(-1); setStatus(""); }
    if (s === "idle") sideIdle();
    if (s === "idle"){ secNow = null; secNote(); }               // (the next Play announces its first section afresh)
    liveButtons();
    remoteSay({ type: "bt-state", state: s });
  }
  loadPreset("basic");
  player = BandPlayer.create({
    parsed: parsedC, tempo: tempo(), transpose: 0,
    instruments: neededSounds(), kit: kitMix(),
    intro: introChoice(), countIn: parseInt($("bt-countin").value, 10), choruses: parseInt($("bt-choruses").value, 10),
    opts: bandOpts(),
    volumes: { bass: vol("bass"), comp: vol("comp"), comp2: vol("comp2"), drums: vol("drums") },
    onState: onState,
    onLoadProgress: function(done, total){ if (state === "loading") setStatus("Loading sounds " + done + " of " + total); },
    onBar: function(info){
      remoteSay({ type: "bt-bar", info: { index: info.index, section: info.section, sectionBar: info.sectionBar, countIn: !!info.countIn, ending: !!info.ending, intro: !!info.intro } });
      if (info.beats > 0) buildBeats(info.beats);            // one dot for each beat of THIS bar (the meter may change inside a tune)
      if (!info.countIn && !info.intro && !info.ending && info.bar >= 0){ nowBar = Math.max(nowBar, info.bar);
        if ($("bt-notation").open){ upcoming(); if (shownChorus !== drawnChorus) drawSoon(); else if (drawnChorus != null) whichSync(); } }       // the last bar of a chorus: turn to the next one
      sideInfo = info;
      showLive(info.countIn ? -1 : info.src);
      setStatus(info.countIn ? "Count-in" : info.intro ? "Intro · bar " + (info.introBar + 1) + " of " + info.introBars : "Chorus " + (info.chorus + 1) + " · bar " + (info.index + 1));
    },
    onBeat: function(info){ showBeat(info.beat); sideBeat(info.beat); remoteSay({ type: "bt-beat", beat: info.beat }); },
    onTempo: function(bpm){ $("bt-tempo").value = bpm; $("bt-tempo-n").value = bpm; },
    hold: $("bt-hold").value === "hold" && chartSections().length > 0,
    sectionLead: /[?&]remote=1/.test(location.search) ? 1 : 0,
    onSection: function(sc){ $("bt-secname").textContent = sc.name ? sc.name : "Section " + (sc.index + 1); if (!sc.early) enterSection(sc.index); remoteSay({ type: "bt-section", index: sc.index, name: sc.name, early: sc.early }); },
    onBarEvents: function(rec){ logBar(rec); },
    onRewind: function(bar){ unlogFrom(bar); }
  });

  function toggle(){
    if (state !== "idle"){ player.stop(); return; }
    player.play().catch(function(){
      onState("idle");
      setStatus("Couldn't load the instrument sounds. Check your connection and try again.", true);
    });
  }

  applyQuery();
  loadHandoff();

  // ---- practice: start bar, cycle, tempo steps ----
  // Bars are FORM bars (the order the band plays them), numbered from 1 in the fields.
  var formSrc = [];
  function numIn(id, lo, hi, dflt){ var v = parseInt($(id).value, 10); return isNaN(v) ? dflt : Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, v)); }
  // A loop whose first bar comes after its last runs over the end of the form (10 to 2 = 10..last, 1, 2).
  var cycEndSet = false, cycAwaitEnd = false;      // has an end bar been chosen; is the next chart click choosing it
  function practice(){
    var n = formSrc.length || 1, a = numIn("bt-cyc-from", 1, n, 1), b = numIn("bt-cyc-to", 1, n, n);
    return { n: n, start: numIn("bt-start", 1, n, 1), cyc: $("bt-cyc-on").checked, from: a, to: b, wrap: a > b };
  }
  function inCycle(p, fi){ return p.wrap ? (fi >= p.from || fi <= p.to) : (fi >= p.from && fi <= p.to); }
  function markChart(){
    var p = practice(), stops = stopBars();
    Array.prototype.forEach.call($("bt-chart").querySelectorAll(".tc-bar[data-bar]"), function(el){
      var fi = formSrc.indexOf(parseInt(el.getAttribute("data-bar"), 10)) + 1;
      el.classList.toggle("bt-cyc", p.cyc && fi >= 1 && inCycle(p, fi));
      el.classList.toggle("bt-cyc-end", p.cyc && fi === p.to && !cycAwaitEnd);
      el.classList.toggle("bt-start", !p.cyc && fi === p.start);
      el.classList.toggle("bt-stop", stops.indexOf(fi - 1) >= 0);
    });
    var over = stops.filter(function(i){ return i >= p.n; }), hint = $("bt-stops-hint");
    hint.hidden = !over.length; hint.textContent = over.length ? "These changes have " + p.n + " bars, so there is no bar " + over.map(function(i){ return i + 1; }).join(", ") + " to stop on." : "";
  }
  function practiceSync(){
    if (!player || !parsedC) return;
    formSrc = BandHarmony.buildForm(parsedC, 0).map(function(b){ return b.src; });
    var p = practice();
    ["bt-start", "bt-cyc-from", "bt-cyc-to"].forEach(function(id){ $(id).max = p.n; });
    $("bt-start").value = p.start; $("bt-cyc-from").value = p.from; $("bt-cyc-to").value = p.to;
    $("bt-start").disabled = p.cyc;                               // a cycle starts at its own first bar
    player.setStartBar((p.cyc ? p.from : p.start) - 1);
    player.setCycle(p.cyc ? p.from - 1 : null, p.to - 1);
    var sa = parseInt($("bt-step-a").value, 10), sb = parseInt($("bt-step-b").value, 10);
    player.setTempoSteps($("bt-step-on").checked && !isNaN(sa) ? (isNaN(sb) ? [sa] : [sa, sb]) : null);
    markChart();
  }
  ["bt-start", "bt-cyc-on", "bt-cyc-from", "bt-cyc-to", "bt-step-on", "bt-step-a", "bt-step-b"].forEach(function(id){
    $(id).addEventListener("change", practiceSync); });
  $("bt-cyc-to").addEventListener("change", function(){ cycEndSet = true; cycAwaitEnd = false; loopNote(); });
  $("bt-cyc-on").addEventListener("change", function(){ cycAwaitEnd = false; loopNote(); });
  function loopNote(){
    var p = practice(), el = $("bt-loop-note");
    el.textContent = !p.cyc ? "" : cycAwaitEnd ? "Loop starts at bar " + p.from + ". Click the bar it should end on."
      : "Looping bars " + p.from + " to " + p.to + (p.wrap ? " (over the end of the form)" : "") + ". Press L to turn the loop off.";
  }
  // L toggles the loop. The first time (no end bar chosen yet) it starts at the Start bar and the next click on the chart sets the end.
  function toggleLoop(){
    var on = !$("bt-cyc-on").checked; $("bt-cyc-on").checked = on;
    if (on && !cycEndSet){ var p = practice(); $("bt-cyc-from").value = p.start; $("bt-cyc-to").value = p.start; cycAwaitEnd = true; }
    else cycAwaitEnd = false;
    loopNote(); practiceSync();
  }
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){
    if ((e.key !== "l" && e.key !== "L") || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey || e.repeat) return;
    var t = e.target, tag = t && t.tagName;
    if (tag === "INPUT" || tag === "TEXTAREA" || tag === "SELECT" || (t && t.isContentEditable)) return;
    e.preventDefault(); toggleLoop();
  });
  $("bt-chart").addEventListener("click", function(e){
    var el = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest(".tc-bar[data-bar]") : null; if (!el) return;
    var fi = formSrc.indexOf(parseInt(el.getAttribute("data-bar"), 10)) + 1; if (fi < 1) return;
    var p = practice();
    if (!p.cyc){ $("bt-start").value = fi; cycEndSet = false; }           // a new starting bar: the loop end is chosen afresh
    else if (e.shiftKey && !cycAwaitEnd) $("bt-cyc-from").value = fi;     // Shift-click moves the first bar of the loop
    else { $("bt-cyc-to").value = fi; cycEndSet = true; cycAwaitEnd = false; }   // a click sets the last bar (before the first = over the end)
    loopNote();
    practiceSync();
  });
  // the chart is redrawn for key, Roman numeral and instrument changes: put the marks back each time
  if (window.MutationObserver) new MutationObserver(markChart).observe($("bt-chart"), { childList: true, subtree: true });
  practiceSync();

  // ---- wire ----
  // Start fetching the sounds on the first touch of any control, so Play is ready sooner.
  $("bt-root").addEventListener("pointerdown", function(){ player.load().catch(function(){}); }, { once:true });
  playBtn.addEventListener("click", toggle);
  $("bt-tempo").addEventListener("input", function(){ $("bt-tempo-n").value = $("bt-tempo").value; player.setTempo(tempo()); });
  $("bt-tempo-n").addEventListener("change", function(){ var t = tempo(); $("bt-tempo-n").value = t; $("bt-tempo").value = t; player.setTempo(t); });
  $("bt-key").addEventListener("change", function(){
    // pinned voicings move with the key: the same shapes, up or down by the smaller distance
    var was = pins, from = parsedC ? parsedC.keyPc : 0, auto = pinAuto;
    pins = null;
    var text = abc; try { text = AbcTranspose.transpose(abc, $("bt-key").value); } catch (e) {}
    applyAbc(text, false);
    if (was){
      var d = (((parsedC.keyPc - from) % 12) + 12) % 12; if (d > 6) d -= 12;
      var map = {}; Object.keys(was.map).forEach(function(k){ map[k] = was.map[k].map(function(m){ return m + d; }); });
      setPins(map, was.count, was.mine); pinAuto = auto;
    }
  });
  $("bt-changes").addEventListener("change", function(){
    var v = $("bt-changes").value, su = /^setup:/.test(v) ? setupByKey(v) : null;
    if (su) applySetup(su); else loadPreset(v);
  });
  // A new meter re-writes the chosen preset and moves the tempo to a usual one for it. Changes that
  // were typed in or handed over keep their own M: line, so the menu goes back to showing that.
  $("bt-meter").addEventListener("change", function(){
    var m = meterDef($("bt-meter").value), ch = $("bt-changes").value;
    var own = ch === "custom" || /^setup:/.test(ch);                    // typed, handed over or saved changes carry their own meter
    if (!m || own){ if (parsedC) showMeter(parsedC); $("bt-abc-note").textContent = own ? "These changes set their own meter: edit the M: line in the ABC below." : ""; return; }
    loadPreset(ch);
    $("bt-tempo").value = m.tempo; $("bt-tempo-n").value = m.tempo; player.setTempo(tempo());
  });
  $("bt-bass").addEventListener("change", function(){ figsSync(); walkSync(true); player.setOpts(bandOpts()); });
  $("bt-walk").addEventListener("input", function(){ player.setOpts(bandOpts()); });
  (function(){ var sel = $("bt-genre"), seen = {}; [["", "All genres"]].concat(STYLES.map(function(x){ return [x.group || "", x.group || ""]; })).forEach(function(g){
    if (seen[g[0]] || (!g[0] && sel.options.length)) return; seen[g[0]] = 1; var o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = g[0]; o.textContent = g[1]; sel.appendChild(o); }); })();
  $("bt-genre").addEventListener("change", function(){ rebuild(false); player.setOpts(bandOpts()); });
  $("bt-figs").addEventListener("change", function(){ player.setOpts(bandOpts()); });
  function timeSync(){ $("bt-timeparts-field").hidden = $("bt-timefeel").value === "normal" || $("bt-timefeel").disabled; }
  $("bt-timefeel").addEventListener("change", function(){ timeSync(); player.setOpts(bandOpts()); });
  $("bt-timeparts").addEventListener("change", function(){ player.setOpts(bandOpts()); });
  $("bt-groove").addEventListener("change", function(){ player.setOpts(bandOpts()); });
  $("bt-feel").addEventListener("change", function(){
    // locked, the feel belongs to the style: the other feel means the plain style of that feel
    var f = $("bt-feel").value;
    if (!unlocked() && styleDef().feel !== f) setStyle(f === "swing" ? "swing" : "boogaloo");
    player.setOpts(bandOpts());
  });
  $("bt-rhythm").addEventListener("change", function(){ rhythmNote(); figsSync(); player.setOpts(bandOpts()); });
  $("bt-style").addEventListener("change", function(){ rebuild(true); player.setOpts(bandOpts()); });
  $("bt-unlock").addEventListener("change", function(){ rebuild(false); player.setOpts(bandOpts()); });
  $("bt-variation").addEventListener("change", function(){ player.setOpts(bandOpts()); });
  $("bt-ride").addEventListener("change", function(){ player.setOpts(bandOpts()); });
  $("bt-ride-sound").addEventListener("change", function(){ player.setOpts(bandOpts()); });
  $("bt-vmove").addEventListener("change", function(){ player.setOpts(bandOpts()); });
  ["bt-ext", "bt-ext-six", "bt-ext-nine", "bt-ext-thirteen"].forEach(function(id){ $(id).addEventListener("change", function(){ extSync(); player.setOpts(bandOpts()); }); });
  $("bt-bass-sound").addEventListener("change", function(){ player.setInstruments(neededSounds()); player.setOpts(bandOpts()); });
  $("bt-stops").addEventListener("input", function(){ fieldsToAbc(); player.setOpts(bandOpts()); markChart(); });
  $("bt-fillbars").addEventListener("input", function(){ fieldsToAbc(); });
  $("bt-fills").addEventListener("change", function(){ player.setOpts(bandOpts()); });
  $("bt-hold").addEventListener("change", sectionsSync);
  $("bt-sec-apply").addEventListener("click", function(){
    var cur = secShown != null ? secShown : secNow; if (cur == null) return;
    var o = pickSec(menuOpts()), list = secSame(cur); if (secShown === cur) list.push(cur);
    list.forEach(function(j){ secOv[j] = { opts: Object.assign({}, o), state: bandState(), sounds: menuSounds() }; });
    secRef = JSON.stringify(o); secNote(); player.setInstruments(neededSounds()); player.setOpts(bandOpts());
  });
  $("bt-sec-reset").addEventListener("click", function(){
    var cur = secShown != null ? secShown : secNow; if (cur == null || !secOv[cur]) return;
    delete secOv[cur]; enterSection(cur, true); player.setOpts(bandOpts());
  });

  function applySetup(s){

    FIELDS.forEach(function(id){ if (id === "bt-comp" || f[id] == null) return; var el = $(id); if (el.tagName !== "SELECT" || has(id, f[id])) el.value = f[id]; });

      Object.keys(put).forEach(function(k){ secOv[k] = { opts: put[k].opts, state: put[k].state, sounds: put[k].sounds || [] }; }); }

    player.setIntro(introChoice()); player.setCountIn(parseInt($("bt-countin").value, 10)); player.setChoruses(parseInt($("bt-choruses").value, 10));
    ["bass", "comp", "comp2", "drums"].forEach(function(part){ player.setVolume(part, vol(part)); }); eqInstSync();

  function setupNote(t){ $("bt-setup-note").textContent = t || ""; }
  // the saved list, here and at the bottom of the Changes menu
  function listSetups(selectName){
    var saved = savedSetups(), list = $("bt-setup-list"), ch = $("bt-changes"), cur = ch.value;
    list.innerHTML = ""; saved.forEach(function(x, i){ var o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = "setup:u:" + i; o.textContent = x.name; list.appendChild(o); });
    if (!saved.length){ var none = document.createElement("option"); none.value = ""; none.textContent = "Nothing saved yet"; list.appendChild(none); }
    ["bt-setup-load", "bt-setup-del", "bt-setup-export", "bt-setup-json-btn"].forEach(function(id){ $(id).disabled = !saved.length; });
    Array.prototype.slice.call(ch.querySelectorAll("optgroup")).forEach(function(g){ g.remove(); });
    [["Built-in setups", BUILTIN, "b"], ["Saved on this device", saved, "u"]].forEach(function(p){
      if (!p[1].length) return; var g = document.createElement("optgroup"); g.label = p[0];
      p[1].forEach(function(x, i){ var o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = "setup:" + p[2] + ":" + i; o.textContent = x.name; g.appendChild(o); }); ch.appendChild(g); });

  $("bt-setup-save").addEventListener("click", function(){
    var name = $("bt-setup-name").value.trim() || (parsedC.title || "Untitled") + ", " + keyField() + ", " + tempo();
    var saved = savedSetups(), at = saved.map(function(x){ return x.name; }).indexOf(name), s = snapshot(name);
    if (at >= 0) saved[at] = s; else saved.push(s);
    if (!storeSetups(saved)){ setupNote("Couldn't save: this browser is blocking storage for the page."); return; }
    listSetups(name); setupNote((at >= 0 ? "Replaced " : "Saved ") + "\u201c" + name + "\u201d. It is in the Changes menu too.");
  });

  $("bt-setup-del").addEventListener("click", function(){
    var m = /^setup:u:(\d+)$/.exec($("bt-setup-list").value), saved = savedSetups(); if (!m || !saved[+m[1]]) return;
    var name = saved[+m[1]].name; saved.splice(+m[1], 1); storeSetups(saved); listSetups(); $("bt-setup-json").hidden = true; setupNote("Deleted \u201c" + name + "\u201d.");
  });

    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove(); setTimeout(function(){ URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); }, 2000);
  });
  function importSetups(text){
    var inc = null; try { inc = JSON.parse(text); } catch (e) {}
    if (inc && !Array.isArray(inc)) inc = [inc];
    inc = (inc || []).filter(function(x){ return x && typeof x.abc === "string" && typeof x.name === "string" && x.name; });
    if (!inc.length){ setupNote("No setups found in that file."); return 0; }
    var saved = savedSetups();
    inc.forEach(function(x){ var at = saved.map(function(y){ return y.name; }).indexOf(x.name); if (at >= 0) saved[at] = x; else saved.push(x); });

  // ---- remote: the page that opened this one (a song on the lyrics site) drives it ----
  // Opened as backing-track.html?remote=1 by window.open. That page sends the song and the transport; this one plays it, with every
  // option here still live, and reports state, bars, beats and sections back so the words can follow. Messages (postMessage, both ways):
  //   in:  bt-load { abc, setup (a saved setup of this page, applied whole on that abc), tempo, style, hold, fills, countIn, melody:[per bar of the ABC, [{pos,dur,midi}] or null], title }
  //        bt-play { startBar }  bt-stop  bt-next  bt-goto { section }  bt-fill  bt-hold { on }  bt-melody { on }
  //        bt-load may also carry versions:[{ name, abc }] (other changes for the same bars), version (the one in abc) and written (the song's own);
  //        bt-chart { abc, melody, version, style, tempo } swaps the changes without touching anything else
  //   out: bt-abc { abc, version (a name, "" as written, null edited here) } whenever the changes here change
  //   out: bt-ready  bt-loaded { bars }  bt-state { state }  bt-bar { info }  bt-beat { beat }  bt-section { index, name, early }
  function remoteOk(o){ return /^https:\/\/([a-z0-9-]+\.)?seancoleman\.org$/.test(o) || /^https?:\/\/(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)(:\d+)?$/.test(o); }

  function remoteTune(){ if (!remote || !remote.melody || !parsedC || parsedC.bars.length !== remote.melody.length) return;
    parsedC.bars.forEach(function(b, i){ if (remote.melody[i]) b.melody = remote.melody[i]; }); }
  function remoteVersionShow(){ var sel = $("bt-remote-version"), ed = sel.querySelector('option[value="*"]');
    if (ed) ed.hidden = remote.version != null; sel.value = remote.version == null ? "*" : remote.version; }
  function remoteVersions(m){ var sel = $("bt-remote-version"); remote.versions = Array.isArray(m.versions) ? m.versions.filter(function(v){ return v && typeof v.abc === "string" && typeof v.name === "string"; }) : [];
    remote.written = typeof m.written === "string" ? m.written : null; sel.textContent = "";
    [{ name: "", label: "As written" }].concat(remote.versions).concat([{ name: "*", label: "Edited here" }]).forEach(function(v){
      var o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = v.name; o.textContent = v.label || v.name; sel.appendChild(o); });
    $("bt-remote-versions").hidden = !(remote.versions.length && remote.written); }
  $("bt-remote-version").addEventListener("change", function(){ var name = this.value, text = name === "" ? remote.written : null;
    remote.versions.forEach(function(v){ if (v.name === name) text = v.abc; });
    if (text == null) return; remote.version = name; applyAbc(text, false); remoteVersionShow(); });
  window.addEventListener("message", function(e){
    var m = e.data; if (!remote.on || !m || typeof m.type !== "string" || m.type.indexOf("bt-") !== 0 || e.source !== window.opener || !remoteOk(e.origin)) return;
    remote.origin = e.origin;
    if (m.type === "bt-load" && typeof m.abc === "string"){
      if (state !== "idle") player.stop();
      remote.loaded = true; remote.melody = m.melody || null; remote.version = typeof m.version === "string" ? m.version : "";
      remoteVersions(m); remoteVersionShow();
      // the song's own saved setup (kept beside it on the lyrics site) sets everything, on the chart that was sent; otherwise style and tempo
      var su = m.setup && typeof m.setup === "object" ? Object.assign({}, m.setup, { abc: m.abc, pins: null }) : null;
      if (su && su.fields){ su.fields = Object.assign({}, su.fields); delete su.fields["bt-stops"]; }          // (stops are in the chart)
      if (!su){ if (m.style) setStyle(m.style);
        if (m.tempo > 0){ $("bt-tempo").value = m.tempo; $("bt-tempo-n").value = m.tempo; }
        $("bt-intro").value = "none"; introSync(); player.setIntro(null); }
      if (!(su ? applySetup(su) : applyAbc(m.abc, false))){ remoteSay({ type: "bt-loaded", bars: 0 }); return; }
      if (su && !(su.tempo > 0) && m.tempo > 0){ $("bt-tempo").value = m.tempo; $("bt-tempo-n").value = m.tempo; }   // (a setup shared between songs carries no tempo)
      $("bt-choruses").value = "1"; player.setChoruses(1); $("bt-cyc-on").checked = false; $("bt-start").value = 1;
      if (m.countIn != null){ $("bt-countin").value = String(m.countIn); player.setCountIn(parseInt($("bt-countin").value, 10)); }
      if (m.fills && !su) $("bt-fills").value = m.fills;
      $("bt-hold").value = m.hold ? "hold" : "through";
      practiceSync(); sectionsSync(); player.setInstruments(neededSounds()); player.setOpts(bandOpts()); player.setTempo(tempo());
      $("bt-remote-song").textContent = m.title ? "\u201C" + m.title + "\u201D" : "a song";
      remoteSay({ type: "bt-loaded", bars: formSrc.length });
    }
    else if (m.type === "bt-chart" && typeof m.abc === "string"){
      if (m.melody) remote.melody = m.melody; remote.version = typeof m.version === "string" ? m.version : "";
      if (m.style) setStyle(m.style);
      if (m.tempo > 0){ $("bt-tempo").value = m.tempo; $("bt-tempo-n").value = m.tempo; player.setTempo(tempo()); }
      applyAbc(m.abc, false); remoteVersionShow();
      if (m.style){ player.setInstruments(neededSounds()); player.setOpts(bandOpts()); } }
    else if (m.type === "bt-play"){ if (state !== "idle") return;
      $("bt-start").value = (m.startBar | 0) + 1; practiceSync(); toggle(); }
    else if (m.type === "bt-stop"){ if (state !== "idle") player.stop(); }
    else if (m.type === "bt-next") player.next();
    else if (m.type === "bt-goto") player.goSection(m.section | 0);

    else if (m.type === "bt-hold"){ $("bt-hold").value = m.on ? "hold" : "through"; sectionsSync(); }

  // ---- what was played: notation + MIDI export (both read the bar log) ----
  function aheadSync(){ player.setAhead($("bt-notation").open); }
  // ---- follow my playing: the microphone's loudness becomes the band's intensity ----
  // The level is relative: a slow floor (the room, or you resting) and a slow ceiling (your loudest) are tracked in
  // decibels, and where the present loudness sits between them, smoothed over a second or two, is sent to the band.
  var follow = null;
  function followFeed(db){
    if (!follow) follow = { level: 0.5, floor: null, ceil: null };
    var f = follow; if (f.floor == null){ f.floor = db; f.ceil = db + 12; }
    f.floor += (db - f.floor) * (db < f.floor ? 0.2 : 0.002); f.ceil += (db - f.ceil) * (db > f.ceil ? 0.3 : 0.004);
    var x = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (db - f.floor) / Math.max(12, f.ceil - f.floor)));
    f.level += (x - f.level) * (x > f.level ? 0.12 : 0.04);
    player.setFollow(f.level);
    $("bt-follow-note").textContent = "Hearing you: " + (f.level < 0.3 ? "quiet" : f.level < 0.65 ? "medium" : "loud") + " (" + Math.round(f.level * 100) + "%)";
    return f.level;
  }
  function followStop(msg){
    if (follow){ if (follow.timer) clearInterval(follow.timer); if (follow.stream) follow.stream.getTracks().forEach(function(t){ t.stop(); }); if (follow.ctx) follow.ctx.close(); }
    follow = null; player.setFollow(null); $("bt-follow").checked = false; $("bt-follow-note").textContent = msg || "";
  }
  function followStart(){
    var md = navigator.mediaDevices; if (!md || !md.getUserMedia){ followStop("This browser gives the page no microphone."); return; }
    $("bt-follow-note").textContent = "Asking for the microphone…";
    md.getUserMedia({ audio: { echoCancellation: false, noiseSuppression: false, autoGainControl: false } }).then(function(stream){
      if (!$("bt-follow").checked){ stream.getTracks().forEach(function(t){ t.stop(); }); return; }
      var AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext, ctx = new AC(), an = ctx.createAnalyser(), buf; an.fftSize = 2048; buf = new Float32Array(an.fftSize);
      ctx.createMediaStreamSource(stream).connect(an);                    // (to the analyser only: you are not played back)
      follow = { level: 0.5, floor: null, ceil: null, stream: stream, ctx: ctx };
      follow.timer = setInterval(function(){ an.getFloatTimeDomainData(buf); var s = 0; for (var i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) s += buf[i] * buf[i];
        followFeed(20 * Math.log(Math.max(1e-5, Math.sqrt(s / buf.length))) / Math.LN10); }, 100);

  }

  window.__follow = { feed: followFeed, stop: followStop };              // for tests
  $("bt-notation").addEventListener("toggle", function(){ aheadSync(); if ($("bt-notation").open) drawNotation(); });
  aheadSync();
  $("bt-nt-drums").addEventListener("change", drawNotation);
  $("bt-nt-refresh").addEventListener("click", drawNotation);
  $("bt-mid-range").addEventListener("change", function(){ $("bt-mid-n-field").hidden = $("bt-mid-range").value !== "last"; });
  $("bt-mid-go").addEventListener("click", exportMidi);

  // ---- the chord diagram beside the chart: the Chord Sheet's superimposed view, embedded ----
  // The first four different chords of the changes on one keyboard (or fretboard, when the guitar comps),
  // drawn by the Chord Sheet page itself (tools/chord-sheet.html?embed=super in a frame), so it is the same
  // picture as there. This page tells it which chord is sounding now and which comes next; those two take
  // the "now" and "next" colours and the others go grey. (The earlier two-chord drawing is archived in
  // apps/shared/band/archive/side-now-next.js.)
  var sideInfo = null, sideSig = "", sideReady = true, sideFrame = null, sideFrameOk = false, sideMsg = null;
  function sideOn(){ return $("bt-side-on").checked; }
  function sideSym(sym){ return String(sym).replace(/\/.*$/, "").replace(/\s+/g, ""); }     // the diagram does not draw a slash bass
  function sideNext(slots, i){ for (var k = 1; k < slots.length; k++){ var o = slots[(i + k) % slots.length]; if (o.chord.key !== slots[i].chord.key) return o; } return null; }
  function sideLine(tag, slot, cls, shown){
    return '<p><span class="bt-sw ' + cls + '"></span><span class="bt-side-tag">' + tag + '</span> ' +
      (slot ? '<b>' + TuneChart.fmtChord(slot.chord.sym, 0, true) + '</b>' + (shown ? "" : " <small>(not one of the four shown)</small>") : "<small>count-in</small>") + '</p>';
  }
  function sideFrameMake(){
    if (sideFrame) return;
    sideFrame = document.createElement("iframe");
    sideFrame.id = "bt-side-frame"; sideFrame.title = "The chords of these changes on one keyboard or fretboard"; sideFrame.setAttribute("scrolling", "no");
    sideFrame.src = "/tools/chord-sheet.html?embed=super";
    $("bt-side").appendChild(sideFrame);
  }
  window.addEventListener("message", function(e){
    if (!sideFrame || e.source !== sideFrame.contentWindow || e.origin !== location.origin || !e.data) return;
    if (e.data.type === "super-embed-ready"){ sideFrameOk = true; if (sideMsg) sideFrame.contentWindow.postMessage(sideMsg, location.origin); }
    else if (e.data.type === "super-embed-size" && e.data.h > 0) sideFrame.style.height = Math.ceil(e.data.h) + "px";
  });
  // show these two slots (either may be null) as now and next
  function sideShow(cur, next){
    var slots = chordSlots(), seen = {}, four = [], total = 0, c = compDef();
    slots.forEach(function(o){ if (seen[o.chord.key]) return; seen[o.chord.key] = 1; total++; if (four.length < 4) four.push(o); });
    function at(o){ if (!o) return null; var k = four.filter(function(x){ return x.chord.key === o.chord.key; })[0]; return k ? sideSym(k.chord.sym) : null; }
    var msg = { type: "super-embed", chords: four.map(function(o){ return sideSym(o.chord.sym); }), comp: c.inst === "guitar" ? "guitar" : "piano",
                voicing: String(voicingChoice()).split("+")[0], now: at(cur), next: at(next) };
    var sig = JSON.stringify(msg) + "|" + (cur && cur.chord.key) + "|" + (next && next.chord.key); if (sig === sideSig) return; sideSig = sig;
    $("bt-side-body").innerHTML = sideLine("Now", cur, "", !cur || msg.now != null) + (next ? sideLine("Next", next, "is-next", msg.next != null) : "") +
      (total > 4 ? "<p><small>The diagram shows the first four of the " + total + " different chords.</small></p>" : "");
    sideMsg = msg; sideFrameMake();
    if (sideFrameOk) sideFrame.contentWindow.postMessage(msg, location.origin);
  }
  function sideBeat(beat){
    if (!sideOn() || !sideInfo || sideInfo.ending) return;
    var slots = chordSlots(), info = sideInfo, i = -1; if (!slots.length) return;
    if (info.countIn || info.index < 0){                                   // before the top: nothing sounds yet, the first chord is next
      var p = practice(), at = (p.cyc ? p.from : p.start) - 1, first = slots.filter(function(o){ return o.bar === at; })[0] || slots[0];
      sideShow(null, first); return; }
    slots.forEach(function(o, k){ if (o.bar === info.index && o.pos <= beat + 1e-6) i = k; });
    if (i >= 0) sideShow(slots[i], sideNext(slots, i));

    var i = 0, p = practice(), at = (p.cyc ? p.from : p.start) - 1;

    sideShow(slots[i], sideNext(slots, i));
  }
  try { if (localStorage.getItem("btSide") === "off") $("bt-side-on").checked = false; } catch (e) {}
  $("bt-side-on").addEventListener("change", function(){ try { localStorage.setItem("btSide", sideOn() ? "on" : "off"); } catch (e) {} sideSig = ""; sideIdle(); });
  ["bt-start", "bt-cyc-on", "bt-cyc-from"].forEach(function(id){ $(id).addEventListener("change", sideIdle); });

  // over to the Chord Entry page with what is here: localStorage.entryHandoff { v, from, at, abc, tempo, pinMap }
  $("bt-to-entry").addEventListener("click", function(){
    try { localStorage.setItem("entryHandoff", JSON.stringify({ v: 1, from: "backing-track", at: Date.now(), abc: abc, tempo: tempo(), style: $("bt-style").value, pinMap: pins ? pins.map : {} })); } catch (e) {}
    if (!window.open("/tools/chord-entry.html?from=backing-track", "_blank")) location.href = "/tools/chord-entry.html?from=backing-track";
  });
  sideIdle();
  $("bt-aswritten").addEventListener("change", function(){ parsedC.asWritten = $("bt-aswritten").checked; barCheck(); if (player) player.setChart(parsedC); });
  booted = true; if (parsedC) abcSettings(abc, parsedC);
  // the list of sections: a link to each panel; a click opens the panel and brings it into view
  (function(){ var root = $("bt-root"), nav = document.createElement("nav"); nav.className = "bt-nav"; nav.id = "bt-nav"; nav.setAttribute("aria-label", "Sections of this page");
    var items = [{ el: root.querySelector(".bt-panel"), label: "Play" }, { el: root.querySelector(".bt-chartrow"), label: "Chart" }];
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(root.children, function(ch){ if (ch.tagName !== "DETAILS" || ch.classList.contains("bt-about")) return; var s = ch.querySelector("summary"); if (!s) return;
      items.push({ el: ch, label: ch.id === "bt-sec-chart" ? "Chart options" : ch.classList.contains("bt-abc") ? "Edit ABC" : s.textContent.trim() }); });
    items.forEach(function(it, i){ if (!it.el) return; if (!it.el.id) it.el.id = "bt-sec-" + i; var a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = "#" + it.el.id; a.textContent = it.label; it.a = a;
      a.addEventListener("click", function(e){ e.preventDefault(); if (it.el.tagName === "DETAILS") it.el.open = true;
        hold = Date.now() + 1500; items.forEach(function(o){ if (o.a) o.a.classList.toggle("on", o === it); });      // (a panel near the foot of the page cannot reach the top: mark it anyway)
        it.el.style.scrollMarginTop = "4.5rem"; it.el.scrollIntoView({ block: "start" });
        setTimeout(function(){ it.el.scrollIntoView({ block: "start" }); }, 250); });      // (again once an opened panel has drawn itself)
      nav.appendChild(a); });
    root.insertBefore(nav, root.firstChild); root.classList.add("bt-has-nav");
    var hold = 0;
    function mark(){ if (Date.now() < hold) return; var cur = null; items.forEach(function(it){ if (it.a && it.el.getBoundingClientRect().top < 140) cur = it; }); items.forEach(function(it){ if (it.a) it.a.classList.toggle("on", it === (cur || items[0])); }); }
    window.addEventListener("scroll", mark, { passive: true }); mark(); })();
  window.addEventListener("pagehide", function(){ if (state !== "idle") player.stop(); });
})();
</script>
